book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.alembic:
Once you understand First Light, look closely at what things are made of. **Sneak and use** one of these to examine it:\
- Sugar\
- Sweet Berries\
- Dried Kelp\
- Spider Eye\
- Bone Meal\
- Honeycomb
Study one at a **Lampwright's Bench**, or read someone's **Research Notes**.
You can now work an **Alembic Crucible**. To **master** the Alembic Arts, bottle 3 different outcomes.
Your Assay Glass now tells you what a dose would do, and why.
Pour in water (a water bucket is 3 parts; at most 6), then use ingredients on it. Bottle with a glass bottle (a draught) or a bowl (a salve).

The crucible takes the heat of what is beneath it: magma 60, a campfire 120, fire 175, lava 220 degrees (nothing: 20). It warms or cools one degree a tick.\
\
**Cold** below 40 (10% a stir), **Warm** from 40 (30% a stir), **Hot** from 90 (55% a stir), **Searing** from 160 (80% a stir).

Ingredients do not dissolve by themselves. Each **stir** (a Stirring Rod or a stick) dissolves a share of what is still pending, more the hotter it is. But a **searing** stir keeps only 85% of the dissolved Radiance and Verdance and fouls the mixture.
A bottle takes one part's share of everything dissolved: that is its dose. The same process always makes the same mixture, so a good one can be made again.
Recording a process, and repeating it
Use a blank formula on a crucible to write down its whole process (water, every ingredient and how it was prepared, every stir and how hot) while nothing has been drawn from it.

Use a written formula on a crucible to set it (**sneak** with an empty hand to clear it). Fed water through a pipe and ingredients through a hopper (up to 5 kinds waiting), it follows the formula step by step, waiting for the heat each stir needs, and bottles into its output when it has bottles. A Pneumatic Extractor at its side takes the brews out, so the fire can stay beneath. It never guesses: a missing ingredient or the wrong heat simply waits.
What ingredients carry, and what it does

- Glowstone Dust: radiance 1.50\
- Glow Berries: radiance 0.60, verdance 0.60\
- Sweet Berries: verdance 1.00\
- Bone Meal: verdance 0.80, hollow 0.30 (contaminant 0.20)\
- Sugar: ember 0.90, tide 0.20\
- Magma Cream: ember 1.60 (contaminant 0.20)\
- Snowball: rime 1.00\
- Amethyst Shard: rime 0.80, radiance 0.40\
- Dried Kelp: tide 1.20\
- Honeycomb: tide 0.60, verdance 0.40\
- Spider Eye: hollow 1.20 (contaminant 0.30)\
- Sunpetal: radiance 1.00, verdance 0.60\
- Dewmoss: tide 1.40, verdance 0.30\
- Gloamcap: hollow 0.90, rime 0.40 (contaminant 0.10)\
- Mendvetch: verdance 1.40

- Radiance: Night Vision from 0.50 a part, 60 s a unit (at most 120 s)\
- Verdance: Regeneration from 0.60 a part, 15 s a unit (at most 22.5 s)\
- Ember: Fire Resistance from 0.60 a part, 60 s a unit (at most 120 s)\
- Rime: Resistance from 0.80 a part, 30 s a unit (at most 60 s)\
- Tide: Water Breathing from 0.60 a part, 60 s a unit (at most 120 s)\
- Hollow: Poison from 0.40 a part, 10 s a unit (at most 21.6 s)\
- Contaminant: Nausea from 0.50 a part, 8 s a unit (at most 20 s)\
\
A dose below a threshold does nothing for that property; too much contaminant brings nausea.
Used as it comes, an ingredient waits to be stirred out. **Ground** in a Mortar and Pestle it loses a tenth, but most of it dissolves the moment it goes in.
Knowing what is in the pot
Tells you how hot the mixture is, how much there is, which property is strongest and whether it is murky.

Measures every property, dissolved and pending, and the contaminant, a part at a time. Once you have mastered the Alembic Arts it also says what a dose would do and why: which property, how strong against its threshold, and which ingredients put it there.
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.artific: Rings forged, reforged, inscribed, socketed and bonded
What each process keeps and destroys

Hold the ring in your main hand and use the bench with, in your other hand: nothing (inspect it); redstone (**reforge**, 6 Focus); a rune's ingredient (**inscribe**, 4 Focus); a gem (**socket**); shears (**unsocket** the last gem); its substrate's ingot (**repair**); a lead (**bond** it to you, 10 Focus, or unbond it); flint (**salvage**, used twice to confirm).

- **Forge**: a new ring: substrate, quality and affixes rolled once\
- **Reforge**: keeps substrate, quality, runes, gems, bond and wear; new affixes\
- **Inscribe**: keeps everything; adds a rune\
- **Socket**: keeps everything; sets a gem\
- **Unsocket**: keeps everything but the last gem, which comes back whole\
- **Bond**: keeps everything; the ring serves only you, with one more capacity\
- **Unbond**: keeps everything but the bond\
- **Repair**: keeps everything; mends wear\
- **Salvage**: gives back some substrate and every gem; destroys quality, affixes, runes and bond

- **Amethyst** (amethyst shard): capacity 2\
- **Emerald** (emerald): capacity 1\
- **Diamond** (diamond): capacity 2\
- **Lapis** (lapis lazuli): capacity 1\
- **Quartz** (quartz): capacity 1

- **Rune of Radiance** (glowstone dust): capacity 2\
- **Rune of Swiftness** (sugar): capacity 2\
- **Rune of Warding** (obsidian): capacity 3\
- **Rune of Vigor** (golden carrot): capacity 2
Wear the ring in a **ring slot**. It wears one point every 30 seconds worn; at its last point it is **dull** and gives nothing until repaired, but it never breaks. A bonded ring serves only its bond.
Use it with ingots in hand to **forge** a Resonant Ring (8 Focus). Its quality and affixes are rolled once, on the server, and kept on the ring; you see them after they are made.

- **Copper**: 4 ingot(s), capacity 4, 1 socket(s), 1 rune slot(s); salvage gives back 2\
- **Iron**: 4 ingot(s), capacity 5, 1 socket(s), 1 rune slot(s); salvage gives back 2\
- **Gold**: 4 ingot(s), capacity 7, 2 socket(s), 2 rune slot(s); salvage gives back 2\
- **Netherite**: 1 ingot(s), capacity 9, 3 socket(s), 2 rune slot(s); salvage gives back 0
A ring's capacity is its substrate's, plus its quality (crude -1, sound 0, fine +1, masterwork +2), plus 1 while bonded. Affixes, runes and gems use it; nothing goes beyond it.

Once you understand First Light, look closely at smithing stock. **Sneak and use** one of these to examine it:\
- Flint\
- Gold Nugget\
- Iron Nugget\
- Lapis Lazuli\
- Nether Quartz
Study one at a **Lampwright's Bench**, or read someone's **Research Notes**. To **master** Runesmithing, enhance rings in three different ways.
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.binding:
Once you understand First Light, look closely at what binds one thing to another. **Sneak and use** one of these to examine it:\
- Lead\
- Name Tag\
- Soul Lantern\
- Saddle\
- Echo Shard
Study one at a **Lampwright's Bench**, or read someone's **Research Notes**.
A familiar, a spirit and a construct will answer you now. To **master** the Binding Arts, be served by each once: a familiar's mending, a spirit's delivery and a construct's trip.
You keep many, and each keeps its own terms.
Your flying librarians and a linked chest workshop

Craft and place a **Storage Lectern**, then use a **Book Wyrm Charm** on it. Each wyrm lets the lectern reach **eight** nearby chests or barrels; four wyrms support **32** links. No research unlock is needed. The supplied wyrm and floating ledger animate in the workshop.

One charm binds one wyrm. Use black, blue, green, purple, red or white dye on your wyrm to choose its color. Breaking the lectern returns its bound charms and removes the corresponding wyrms; the storage contents stay in their original chests.

Use a **Dominion Wand** on the lectern to select it, then on each chest or barrel within **30 blocks**. Sneak-use a linked chest to remove its link. The owner's party can use the lectern, but every linked container must also permit access. Unlock locked containers directly first. Repositories and Archwood chests can also be linked; Ender chests remain private. Empty lecterns can link to another lectern as a remote terminal.

Use the lectern empty-handed. Search the combined item catalog, click to request a stack, right-click for one, or shift-click to withdraw directly. Craft with the adjacent grid and cycle named inventory groups. Sneak-use opens the older individual-container view. A double chest's halves can be linked separately. Put down any cursor-held stack before changing pages. **Unlink chest** removes only the connection. The setup-tip button cycles through the steps.

A lost wyrm disables excess links; binding a replacement restores that capacity. An unloaded, locked or newly protected chest stays unavailable. The lectern never loads chunks or copies items into a second hidden inventory. Walk away or remove the lectern and access closes. Book Wyrms visit the links visually; they do not carry a second copy of the contents.

Unfold it on a block. Use a **Porter Key** on two containers (its source and its target), then on the porter. It carries 16 items a trip, spends 2 Ley Charge a trip (it holds 64, drawn from a Ley Pylon by its source that you may use) and wears 1 of its 64 integrity; each copper ingot mends 16.

Use the post with an item in your hand to **request** a stack of exactly that item (a named or enchanted one is not a plain one). Bind a Porter Key to the post, then use the key on a Clockwork Porter: it serves the post, fetching from containers within 8 blocks into the post's 9 slots (a hopper below takes them out).

One courier takes a request at a time and **reserves** what it will carry, so two never reach for the same items. What a courier has picked up is held by the post's ledger, not by the courier: if it is broken, unloaded or the world restarts, its cargo waits at the post for another courier, or for you (**/jugcraft concordance logistics recover**). A full post keeps the rest in transit; a cancelled request, or one whose post is broken, takes its cargo back first.

Use the post with an empty hand to read its last steps. **/jugcraft concordance logistics** lists your requests; **request** asks for a number of what you hold; **cancel** and **recover** take a request's number:\
- **open**: waiting for a courier\
- **claimed**: a courier is on it\
- **in transit**: in transit\
- **stranded**: stranded at the post (its courier is gone)\
- **returning**: being taken back
Familiars, spirits and constructs: bonds, agreements and bodies
Use it to bind a **Hearthling**: one familiar a person. It keeps within 8 blocks of you and, when you are badly hurt, mends you. Use the charm again to call it to your side; sneak to release it.

The bond grows by time spent together, 1 a visit and at most 24 a day, and fades by 4 for each day you are online but away from it. At 20 it mends you (at most once a minute); at 60, twice as often. It never follows you into another dimension and never waits in a place that is not loaded: it simply waits where it is.
What a worker can tell you

Look at a worker (Jade), use it with an empty hand, or ask **/jugcraft concordance workers** (which also lists workers that are not loaded, with what they last said):\
- **following**: following its person\
- **supporting**: mending its person\
- **travelling**: on its way\
- **working**: working\
- **returning**: taking what it carries home\
- **idle**: idle: nothing to do\
- **waiting for resources**: waiting for resources (its source is empty or gone)\
- **blocked by access**: blocked: its keeper may not take from or give to that place\
- **cannot navigate**: cannot find a way there\
- **outside agreement**: outside its agreement (the hours, the area or the work)\
- **finished**: finished: its work for the day is done\
- **owner offline**: waiting: its person is not here\
- **other dimension**: waiting: its person or route is in another dimension\
- **destination unloaded**: waiting: its destination is not loaded\
- **suspended**: suspended by its holder\
- **needs repair**: needs repair (copper)\
- **no energy**: out of Ley Charge (a pylon by its source fuels it)\
- **full**: full: there is no room to deliver\
- **disabled**: switched off

Use it to seal an **agreement** with a Gathering Shade, recorded as a Bound Will: it gathers dropped items within 8 blocks of the anchor, from 19:00 to 05:00, at most 64 times a day, carrying 16 at a time, and brings them to the anchor (hoppers below take them out).

Outside its hours, its area or its work it waits at the anchor and says so; when its day's work is done it is finished until tomorrow. It never takes what you could not take yourself (a protected town). Sneak and use the anchor to **suspend** or resume it; break the anchor to **release** it: it leaves what it carried and departs.
A walking courier for your connected workshop

Craft a **Starbuncle Charm** and use it on clear ground. You can keep **eight** Starbuncles within the shared 32-worker roster. No research is required. Offer a gold nugget to a wild Starbuncle, then enchant its token with four gold ingots at the apparatus.

Use a **Dominion Wand** on your Starbuncle, then on a **pickup** chest or barrel, then on a **delivery** chest or barrel. The two containers must be different and within **32 blocks** of each other. Stay near the Starbuncle while setting up. Sneak-use a chest to restart pickup selection; use the wand on a lectern to return to storage-link mode.

Your courier walks to pickup, takes up to **16 items** of one kind, and walks to delivery. Keep a clear walkable route. Each double-chest half is separate. It works while you are in the dimension, unless your server enables absent-owner workers. Items keep their names and components. No power, food upkeep or additional currency is required.

Empty pickup, full destination, blocked paths, locked/protected storage or unloaded chunks make the worker wait and report its status. Use it empty-handed to inspect. It never loads chunks. A carrying worker cannot be rerouted. **Sneak-use empty-handed** to pack it up: the charm and actual cargo drop at its feet. Death returns them too; unload/reload keeps them on the same entity.

Use any vanilla dye to choose among all **16 supplied colors**. Packing preserves the color on the charm. Your party can manage your couriers, but storage permissions are checked again as their owner at every transfer. Repositories and Archwood chests are supported; Ender chests remain private. Apply filter scrolls, a path block, shades, a Wixie hat, or extra charms to configure the courier. Use the Dominion Wand to select a new route once its current cargo is delivered.
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.circles:
Attunes an Initiate's Wand into an Adept's Wand, which holds larger spells. What is inscribed and tuned on the wand stays.\
\
**Offer:** 1 Initiate's Wand, 4 Amethyst Shard, 2 Gold Ingot, 4 Glowstone Dust.\
**Takes:** one practitioner, 6 Focus each, 5 steps (10 seconds), drawing 2 Ley Charge from each pylon a step (40 in all).
An Adept's Wand holds spells of up to 12 capacity, 8 targets and 72 work, with up to 2 branches (the Initiate's Wand: 8, 6, 48 and 1). Take it from the anchor once the ritual completes.

Once you understand First Light, look at things made to **hold a shape or a bearing**. **Sneak and use** one to examine it.\
\
Circle specimens:\
- Compass\
- Lead\
- Calcite\
- Chiseled Stone Bricks
Examine a second, different circle specimen.
Study a circle specimen at a **Lampwright's Bench**, or read **Research Notes** from someone who understands Circle Lore.

You can now work **rituals**: build a Lesser Circle and begin one at its anchor.\
\
To **master** Circle Lore, complete rituals in 3 different chunks.
Your circles hold. Rituals you complete still count for the codex, but mastery asks nothing more of you.
The Circlewrights' practice: rituals, their circles and their risks
A ritual is worked at a **Circle Anchor**, inside a circle built round it.

With the anchor at the centre:\
- a **Ley Pylon** two blocks out to the north, south, east and west (the **channels**);\
- a **Warding Stone** three blocks out in those four directions and two out on each diagonal (the **boundary**);\
- two blocks of **open air** above the anchor.\
\
All on the anchor's level. It works built facing any way.

Use the anchor with an empty hand to hear what is wrong: a part **missing**, the **wrong block**, the space **obstructed**, a pylon **without charge** or **someone else's**, or part of it **out of reach** (an unloaded chunk). Jade shows the first faults at a glance, and `/jugcraft concordance circle` reads the whole circle.
Any block in the ritual boundary tag will hold; these are made for it.
A pylon holds up to 64 **Ley Charge**, the working energy rituals draw. Each step of a ritual draws from every pylon in the circle at once, all or none.

**From a Kindled Lantern:** use the lantern on the pylon. Every 3 Radiance becomes 2 Ley Charge, up to 15 Radiance a pour; what does not convert stays in the lantern.\
\
**From electricity:** connect any Jugcraft power source. Every 1000 JE becomes 1 Ley Charge, at up to 64 JE a tick.\
\
Nothing turns Ley Charge back.
The pylon belongs to whoever placed it. A ritual draws only from pylons owned by someone taking part (or by no one).

Two practitioners keep a vigil in the dark: each is shielded, and creatures nearby are outlined.\
\
**Offer:** 4 Glow Berries.\
**Takes:** 2 practitioners, 4 Focus each, 3 steps (6 seconds), drawing 1 Ley Charge from each pylon a step (12 in all). It must be dark: light 7 or less above the anchor.
Each participant gains 8 points of absorption for 2 minutes, and up to 16 creatures within 16 blocks glow for a minute. It needs two people, but nothing else in the Concordance needs it.
What a ritual takes, and what it risks

Put the **offerings** in the anchor (use it with each). Then use it with an **empty hand**: the anchor finds the ritual the offerings answer, checks the circle, and takes your **Focus**. A ritual for more than one waits 30 seconds for the others, who join the same way. **Sneak** with an empty hand to take your offerings back before it begins.

Every 2 seconds the ritual checks the whole circle again and draws Ley Charge. Every participant must stay within 4 blocks of the circle's edge. The offerings are **held**: nothing can be added or taken until it ends. The leader can call it off by sneaking with an empty hand.

**Completed:** the offerings are used and the result is made, both at the same moment, once.\
\
**Broken off** (a part broken, a pylon dry, someone gone, too bright, the anchor's chunk unloaded or the server restarted): nothing is made, the offerings stay in the anchor for you to take back or try again, and the Focus and Ley Charge already spent are gone.

If a **Warding Stone** is lost while a ritual runs, the working lashes out: every participant takes its backlash. The offerings are still returned. If the anchor itself is broken, they drop where it stood.
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.composi: Once First Light is understood you can write spells of your own. A spell is a few words in order: a **delivery** (how it leaves you), a **selection** (what it chooses where it lands), one to 3 **operations** (what it does) and an optional **ending**. Join a **modifier** to the word it changes with **+**, and write **then** before a second spell that starts where the first landed.

Hold an instrument and open the **Spell Composer**: press **J** for your journal and choose **Compose** (or bind its own key in Controls). Choose words from those you know, or type the spell; the composer checks it as you go and says what it does and costs, or exactly why it cannot work. **Inscribe** writes it on the instrument and it appears on your spell bar.

The same can be done in chat: `/jugcraft concordance compose check` and the spell explains it, `compose inscribe` writes it on the instrument, `compose show` reads it back and `compose clear` wipes it. The composer and the commands give the same answer.

- `touch struck light`: Light where you touch (2 Focus)\
- `here struck ward`: Ward yourself (3 Focus)\
- `touch struck ward`: Ward the friend you touch: soaking 4 health in a lair fight earns your share (3 Focus)\
- `ray struck sear then here creatures dazzle`: Sear what you aim at, then dazzle what stands round it (8 Focus)

The Initiate's Wand holds 8 capacity of words. A spell on it reaches at most 6 different targets, does at most 48 work, branches at most 1 time and lasts at most 60 seconds.\
\
A spell costs the Focus of its words (an operation's for every pulse), taken once when it takes effect: a spell that does nothing costs nothing. Its cooldown is half a second and a quarter second for each Focus, and lasts at least as long as it pulses.

`here`: The spell lands where you stand; after then, where the spell before it landed.\
\
No reach: it lands at once. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 1, Focus 0.

`touch`: The spell lands on the first creature or surface within reach.\
\
Reach: 4 blocks. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 1, Focus 0.

`nouveau_underfoot`: Targets the spell on the block beneath the player.\
\
No reach: it lands at once. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_wall`: Creates a lingering wall that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.\
\
Reach: 6 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`ray`: A straight line of light: the spell lands on the first creature or surface it meets.\
\
Reach: 16 blocks. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 2, Focus 1.

`nouveau_linger`: Creates a lingering field that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.\
\
Reach: 6 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_orbit`: Summons three orbiting projectiles around the target that will cast a spell on any entities it may hit. Additional projectiles, their speed, radius, and duration may be augmented. Sensitive will cause Orbit to hit blocks.\
\
No reach: it lands at once. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_pantomime`: Applies spells to the nearest block in your line of sight. Dampen will reduce the distance, Amplify will increase it. Sensitive will highlight the selected block.\
\
Reach: 24 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_projectile`: Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. Sensitive will allow Projectiles to break plants or other materials that do not block motion.\
\
Reach: 24 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_rune`: Places a rune on the ground that will cast the spell on targets that touch the rune. Unlike runes placed by Runic Chalk, these runes are temporary and cannot be recharged. When using Item Pickup, items are deposited into adjacent inventories. Sensitive will cause the rune to use the Owner's inventory for pickup and usage instead. Players with Magic Find will be able to read spells inscribed on runes.\
\
Reach: 6 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_self`: Applies spells on the caster.\
\
No reach: it lands at once. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_touch`: Applies spells at the block or entity that is targeted.\
\
Reach: 6 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`pulse`: Acts three times, a second apart, where it first landed. Its operations cost Focus for each time.\
\
3 times, every 1 seconds. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 2, Focus 0.

`intensify`: Half as strong again (at least one more): joined to an operation.\
\
+50% strength. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`prolong`: Twice as long: joined to an operation that lasts.\
\
+100% time. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_extend_time`: Extends the time that spells last, including buffs, fangs, and summons\
\
+100% time. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_extract`: Applies a silk-touch effect to Break and causes Explosion to not destroy blocks that drop. Cannot be combined with Fortune.\
\
Extract tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_fortune`: Increases the drop chance from mobs killed by Damage and blocks that are destroyed by Break. Cannot be combined with Extract.\
\
Fortune tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_pierce`: When applied to the Projectile spell, projectiles may continue through their path an additional time after hitting a mob or block. Causes certain effects to also target the block behind them, like Break. Combines with AOE to provide depth.\
\
Pierce tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_randomize`: Randomize the behavior of some glyphs. If used with spells like Place Block and Exchange, it will randomize the block that is placed between the blocks in your hotbar.\
\
Randomize tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_sensitive`: Causes forms to target blocks they normally cannot target. Projectile and Orbit will target grass, and Touch will target fluids and air. Changes targeting rules of certain effects.\
\
Sensitive tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_split`: Causes multiple projectiles to be cast at once. Each projectile applies a set of effects.\
\
Split tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`widen`: Two blocks wider: joined to creatures or spread.\
\
+2 blocks radius. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`extend`: Eight blocks further: joined to touch or ray.\
\
+8 blocks range. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_accelerate`: Increases the speed of projectile spells.\
\
Accelerate tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_amplify`: Additively increases the power of most spell effects. Can increase the harvest level of Break and increases the damage of spells.\
\
+50% strength. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_aoe`: Spells will affect a larger area around a targeted block.\
\
+1 blocks radius. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_dampen`: Decreases the power of most spells.\
\
Reduces strength by 50%. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_decelerate`: Decreases the speed of projectile spells.\
\
Decelerate tier 1. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_duration_down`: Reduces the duration of spells like potion effects, delay, redstone signal, and others.\
\
Reduces duration by 50%. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`light`: Sets a Kindled mote in open air you may build in.\
\
Lasts 32 seconds. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`reveal`: Makes a creature glow, seen through walls. Revealing another player counts as harming them.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 1, Focus 1.

`nouveau_cold_snap`: Causes wet, slowed, or freezing entities to take a burst of damage and erupt into falling ice. Falling ice will slow and damage nearby entities. Can also be used to erupt a block of ice instead. Falling blocks of ice can be manipulated with the Focus of Block Shaping. Entities afflicted with Freezing will be set to the maximum freeze level immediately.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_conjure_water`: Places water at a location or extinguishes entities on fire. If augmented with extend time, it will keep entities wet for a longer period of time.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_craft`: Opens the crafting menu.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_crush`: Turns stone into gravel, and gravel into sand. Will also crush flowers into bonus dye. Need Sensitive to work on items. For full recipe support, see JEI. Will also harm entities and deals bonus damage to entities that are swimming.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_cut`: Simulates using shears on entities and blocks, or damages non-shearable entities for a small amount. Amplify will simulate using an Axe instead of Shears. For simulating breaking with shears, see Break and Sensitive. Costs nothing.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 0.

`nouveau_delay`: Delays the resolution of effects placed to the right of this spell for a few moments. The delay may be increased with the Extend Time augment, or decreased with Duration Down.\
\
Lasts 1 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_dispel`: Removes any potion effects on the target. When used on a witch at half health, the witch will vanish in return for a Wixie shard. Will also dispel tamed summons back into their charm.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_ender_inventory`: Opens your personal ender chest inventory from anywhere.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_evaporate`: Deletes fluids in an area. Can be expanded with AOE.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_exchange`: When used on blocks, exchanges the blocks in the players hotbar for the blocks hit as if they were mined with silk touch. Can be augmented with AOE, and Amplify is required for swapping blocks of higher hardness. When used on entities, the locations of the caster and the entity hit are swapped.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`ward`: A shell of light that absorbs harm (Absorption).\
\
Absorbs up to 4 damage for 10 seconds. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 2, Focus 3.

`nouveau_explosion`: Causes an explosion at the location. Amplify increases the damage and size by a small amount, while AOE will increase the size of the explosion by a large amount, but not damage.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_fangs`: Summons Evoker Fangs in the direction where the spell was targeted. Using fangs on your self will spawn them in an area around you.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_fell`: Harvests entire trees, mushrooms, cactus, and other vegetation. Can be amplified with Amplify to break materials of higher hardness. AOE will increase the number of blocks that may be broken at one time.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_firework`: Creates a firework at the location or entity. Amplify will add Firework Stars, while Extend Time will add additional flight time. If a firework exists in the casters inventory, the created firework will mimic the held one. Spell Turrets with Touch will create fireworks as if they were dispensed.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_flare`: When used on an entity or block that is on fire or afflicted with Blasting, Cinders will explode around the target, dealing damage and creating Mage Fire nearby. Mage Fire cannot spread to blocks and is short lived. Entities with Blasting will immediately explode for extra strength.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_freeze`: Freezes water or lava in a small area or slows a target for a short time. Freeze on Ice will turn it into Packed Ice, and Packed Ice into Blue Ice. Sensitive will turn water into Frosted Ice and will vanish after a short time.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_glide`: Grants the Glide effect, allowing the wearer to fly as if they were wearing an Elytra. \
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_gravity`: Causes blocks and entities to fall. When augmented with Extend Time, players will have their flight disabled and will obtain the Gravity effect. While afflicted with Gravity, entities will rapidly fall and take double falling damage.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_grow`: Causes plants to accelerate in growth as if they were bonemealed.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_gust`: Knocks a target or block away a short distance from the caster. Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`sear`: Light that burns: arcane damage, credited to you.\
\
4 damage. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 2, Focus 3.

`nouveau_harm`: Damages a target. May be increased by Amplify, or applies the Poison debuff when using a Time augment. Note, multiple Harms without a delay will not apply due to invincibility on hit.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_harvest`: When used on grown crops, this spell will obtain the fully grown product without destroying the plant.\
\
Applies once. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_heal`: Heals a small amount of health and consumes hunger from the caster. When used on Undead, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic damage.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_hex`: Applies the Hex effect. Hex increases any damage taken by a small amount while the user is afflicted by poison, wither, fire, or when frozen. Additionally, Hex cuts the rate of Mana Regeneration and healing in half.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_ignite`: Sets blocks and mobs on fire for a short time. Sensitive will summon Mage Fire, a shorter lived fire that will not spread or destroy blocks.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_infuse`: Infuses a target with a potion or flask from your inventory. If augmented with AOE, a splash potion will spawn at the location. If augmented with Extend Time, a lingering potion will spawn at the location. Caster blocks may pull from adjacent Potion Jars to cast infuse.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_intangible`: Causes blocks to temporarily turn into air. Can be modified with Amplify for blocks of higher hardness, AOE, Duration Down, and Extend Time.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_interact`: Interacts with blocks or entities as it were a player. Useful for reaching levers, chests, or animals. Sensitive will use your off-hand item on the block or entity, Amplify will use left-click instead of right-click on blocks.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_invisibility`: Causes the target to turn invisible for a short time.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_launch`: Launches an entity or block into the air. Can be used for large jumps, yeeting mobs in the sky or for scaling mountains! Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`dazzle`: Dazzled creatures stumble (Slowness).\
\
Level 1 for 3 seconds. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_leap`: Launches the target in the direction they are looking. Amplification will increase the distance moved.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_light`: If cast on a block, a permanent light source is created. May be amplified up to Glowstone brightness, or Dampened for a lower light level. When cast on yourself, you will receive night vision. When cast on other entities or with Sensitive, they will receive Night Vision and Glowing. If Sensitive, Glowing will use the spell color. Particles can be configured from the Spell Style menu in the spellbook.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_lightning`: Summons a lightning bolt at the location. Entities struck will be given the Shocked effect. Shocked causes all additional lightning damage to deal bonus damage, and increases the level of Shocked up to III. Lightning also deals bonus damage to entities that are wet or wearing RF powered items. Can be augmented with Amplify, Dampen, and Extend Time.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_name`: Names an entity after the set Spell Name. Targeting a block will name nearby entities or name inventory blocks directly if possible. Targeting with Self will name the held offhand item. Can be overridden with a name tag in the hotbar.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_phantom_block`: Creates a temporary block that will disappear after a short time. Amplify will cause the block to be permanent. Dispelling this block will destroy it instantly. Casting on an entity will create blocks around them in the upwards direction.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_pickup`: Picks up nearby items in a medium radius where this spell is activated. The range may be expanded with AOE.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_place_block`: Places blocks from the casters inventory. If cast by a player, this spell will place blocks from the hot bar first. Casting on an entity will place the blocks beneath the entity in the up direction. Sensitive causes the block to be placed in the caster's facing direction, two Sensitives will place it in the opposite direction.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_prestidigitation`: Places an invisible temporary block that emits particles. Amplify will make this block permanent. Particles can be configured from the Spell Style menu in the spellbook. Targeting an entity will emit particles centered on them instead.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_pull`: Pulls the target closer to the caster. When used on blocks, they become falling blocks with motion towards the side of the block that was hit. Sensitive will stop this spell from pulling blocks.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_redstone_signal`: Places a temporary block of redstone with configurable power and duration. Augment with Sensitive to set the target block as a power source for itself and surrounding blocks. Dampen and Amplify will adjust the power from the base value of 10.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_animate_block`: Animates a block to fight for you. The animated block will convert to a falling block when it dies. Costs a large amount of mana, but does not grant Summoning Sickness\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_rotate`: Rotates a block or an entity clockwise. If augmented with sensitive it will change the axis of the block (if possible) or force the entity to turn their look. Dampen will rotate counter-clockwise.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_sense_magic`: Applies Magic Find to the target, causing magical mobs to glow within 75 blocks of them. Magic Find also reveals spells on Runes.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_slowfall`: Applies the Slow Fall buff.\
\
Level 1 for 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_smelt`: Smelts blocks and items in the world. AOE will increase the number of items and radius of blocks that can be smelted at once, while Amplify will allow Smelt to work on blocks of higher hardness, Sensitive will make it only smelt items and not blocks. Dampen will cause Smelt to use smoking recipes.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_snare`: Stops entities from moving and jumping. Extend Time will increase the duration of this effect. Snaring a block created from the Focus of Block Shaping will cause it to attempt to place itself immediately.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_summon_decoy`: Summons a decoy of yourself. Upon summoning, the decoy will attract any nearby mobs to attack it.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_summon_steed`: Summons a saddled horse that will vanish after a few minutes. AOE will increase the amount summoned, while Extend Time will increase the duration of the summon. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, and cannot be cast while afflicted by this Sickness.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_summon_undead`: Summons a number of Skeleton allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Skeletons will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.  Additionally, their summoned weapons are changed using augments, use Amplify to give it a better sword, or Pierce to give it a bow.  Adding Split after the effect will add to the number of summoned skeletons.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_summon_vex`: Summons three Vex allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Vex will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_summon_wolves`: Summons two wolves that will fight with you. Extend Time will increase the amount of time on the summons. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, preventing other summoning magic.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_blink`: Teleports the caster to a location. If an entity is hit and the caster is holding a Warp Scroll in the offhand, the entity will be warped to the location on the Warp Scroll. When used on Self, the caster blinks forward. Spell Turrets and Runes can warp entities using Warp Scrolls from adjacent inventories without consuming the scroll.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_toss`: Causes the caster to place an item from their inventory to a location. If this glyph is used on an inventory, the item will attempt to be inserted into it. Toss throws 64 items by default. Dampen will halve the amount each time. Amplify will double the amount each time. Randomize will select a random stack.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_wind_burst`: Activates a wind charge at the target location, knocking entities back. Sensitive will allow the caster to ignore the knockback.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_wind_shear`: Deals damage to targets in the air, with an increasing amount based on how high the target is off the ground, up to 10 blocks. Targets on the ground take no damage.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_wither`: Applies the Wither debuff.\
\
Level 1 for 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_reset`: Resets the spell chain to the original target if it was changed by a previous effect. For example, Burst -> Place Block -> Reset -> Break will cause Burst to place blocks, but only Break will apply to the original location. As a result, using Reset will allow you to bypass combination and duplicate limits on glyphs.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_rewind`: Rewinds an entity back in time to its previous locations and health. Can revert blocks that were moved with spells back into solid blocks. Glyphs that come after Rewind will be cast at the end of the rewind, as if they were Delayed.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_wololo`: Changes the color of an entity or compatible block to the color of the spell.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_bounce`: Gives players the Bounce effect, causing them to bounce upwards upon falling. Amplification of Bounce will preserve additional forward facing motion per bounce.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_break`: Breaks blocks of an average hardness. Can be amplified to increase the harvest level. Sensitive will simulate breaking blocks with Shears instead of a pickaxe.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`nouveau_bubble`: Captures mobs and entities it touches, causing them to float upwards. If the bubble has been alive for at least one tick, damaging the entity trapped in the bubble will cause it to pop, dealing bonus damage to the entity inside. Extend time and amplify can be used to increase the duration and damage of the bubble.\
\
Lasts 10 seconds. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 2.

`struck`: Acts on the one thing the delivery reached: the creature, or else the block.\
\
One target. Needs First Light understood. Capacity 0, Focus 0.

`creatures`: Acts on the creatures nearest to where the spell lands. A harmful operation never touches you.\
\
Up to 4 creatures within 3 blocks. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 2, Focus 2.

`spread`: Acts on the blocks nearest to where the spell lands that the operation can work on (lights keep two blocks apart).\
\
Up to 4 blocks within 3 blocks. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 2, Focus 2.

`allies`: Acts on you and the members of your party nearest to where the spell lands. Only helpful operations may choose allies.\
\
Up to 4 of you and your party within 4 blocks. Needs First Light mastered. Capacity 2, Focus 2.

`nouveau_burst`: Resolves the spell in a spherical area around the target. Augment with Sensitive to target blocks instead of entities and Dampen to make an empty sphere. Augment with AOE to increase the radius. \
\
Up to 8 creatures within 3 blocks. Needs First Light encountered. Capacity 1, Focus 1.
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.conclav: The fellowship of the traditions: renown, commissions and projects
The Starbound Conclave
Renown, ranks, commissions and shared projects
The Starbound Conclave

The Conclave is the fellowship of the Concordance's traditions, and its factions are those traditions: every research entry belongs to one. Once you understand First Light, use a **Conclave Lectern** (or **/jugcraft concordance conclave join**) to swear its oath. It replaces nothing: your party stays your party and Jugs stay the only coin. Renown is standing, never spent.
The Starbound Conclave

Renown comes from four kinds of work, each bounded so no one repeated deed can carry you: **research** (each state an entry reaches, once: 1, 2, 5, 10), **commissions** (each once a week, worth less each time, nothing after its third), **teaching** (someone advanced an entry by reading your notes: 3 renown, once per entry and learner, 4 per learner) and **projects** (each stage you helped, and the whole project, once).
Renown

A rank asks for renown, breadth and variety together.\
- **Aspirant**: 0 renown, 0 traditions with at least 5 renown each, 0 kinds of work; commissions up to tier 1\
- **Fellow**: 25 renown, 2 traditions with at least 5 renown each, 2 kinds of work; commissions up to tier 2; may begin projects\
- **Companion**: 80 renown, 4 traditions with at least 5 renown each, 2 kinds of work; commissions up to tier 3; may begin projects\
- **Luminary**: 160 renown, 5 traditions with at least 5 renown each, 3 kinds of work; commissions up to tier 3; may begin projects\
- **Starbound**: 260 renown, 6 traditions with at least 5 renown each, 3 kinds of work; commissions up to tier 3; may begin projects
Ranks

A member contributes something each week. A lapsed member keeps every point of renown but takes no tier II or III commission and begins no project until they contribute again; any contribution restores them. **/jugcraft concordance conclave** shows your standing, what the next rank needs and your obligation.
Obligations

Hold what a commission asks for and use a lectern, or **/jugcraft concordance conclave fulfil <commission>**; practice commissions need only the practice carried through this week. **/jugcraft concordance conclave commissions** lists them and whether each is open to you.\
- **Oil for the Lamps** (Lampwrights, tier 1): bring 16 glowstone dust; 4 renown, then 2, then 1; pays 2 amethyst shards\
- **The Seed Store** (Greenwardens, tier 1): bring 32 wheat seeds; 4 renown, then 2, then 1; pays 2 emeralds\
- **Clean Vials** (Alembists, tier 1): bring 12 glass bottles; 4 renown, then 2, then 1; pays 2 experience bottles\
- **The First Watch** (Starwatchers, tier 1): an observation of the sky in the last week; 4 renown, then 2, then 1; pays 2 amethyst shards\
- **Witness to the Circle** (Circlewrights, tier 2): a ritual completed in the last week; 8 renown, then 4, then 2; pays 4 experience bottles\
- **A Service Rendered** (Spiritbinders, tier 2): a bound worker's service in the last week; 8 renown, then 4, then 2; pays 3 emeralds\
- **A Fair Weight** (Balancewrights, tier 2): a dissolving at the scale in the last week; 8 renown, then 4, then 2; pays 3 emeralds\
- **A Gift for the Vigil** (Crimson Vigil, tier 2): bring 24 sweet berries; 8 renown, then 4, then 2; pays 3 emeralds\
- **Runework for the Archive** (Runesmiths, tier 3): work at the Artificer's Bench in the last week; 12 renown, then 6, then 3; pays 1 diamond\
- **A Dream Recorded** (Dreamwalkers, tier 3): a dream come back from in the last week; 12 renown, then 6, then 3; pays 2 ender pearls\
- **The Hex Ledger** (Hexweavers, tier 3): a curse cast in the last week; 12 renown, then 6, then 3; pays 4 emeralds\
- **The Garden Census** (Greenwardens, tier 3): a living device tended in the last week; 12 renown, then 6, then 3; pays 1 diamond
Commissions

A project to chart the starward sky from the Conclave's lenses and vigils, for one player or a whole party. Finished, it brings every contributor 30 renown and 2 diamonds.\
- **Grinding the Lenses** (8 renown each): 32 glass panes; 8 amethyst shards; a contributor who understands Celestial Attunement; 2 contributors, or contributions on 2 different days\
- **Keeping the Vigils** (10 renown each): an observation of the sky (3); a ritual completed (1); 2 contributors, or contributions on 3 different days\
- **Drawing the Chart** (12 renown each): 16 paper; 4 gold ingots; 1 compass; 3 contributors, or contributions on 3 different days
The Starward Chart

A project to gather the Concordance's learning into one archive, for one player or a whole party. Finished, it brings every contributor 30 renown and 8 experience bottles.\
- **Raising the Shelves** (8 renown each): 12 books; 32 oak planks; 2 contributors, or contributions on 2 different days\
- **The Readings** (10 renown each): a contributor who understands First Light; a contributor who understands Alembic Arts; a mixture bottled (2); 2 contributors, or contributions on 2 different days\
- **The Catalogue** (12 renown each): 16 paper; 8 ink sacs; 4 feathers; 3 contributors, or contributions on 3 different days
The Concordance Archive

From Fellow, begin a project for yourself (**/jugcraft concordance conclave project start <project> personal**) or, as your party's leader, for your party (**... party**). Your own projects take only your work; your party's take any member's. Every stage that asks for several contributors also accepts the solo way: contributions on that many different days. Together a party finishes sooner, and every member who helped shares the achievement and the reward. Sneak and use a lectern with items to give them; use it with an empty hand to present what you understand; practices count by themselves. **/jugcraft concordance conclave project** shows progress anywhere.
Projects, Alone or Together

A lectern serves the project of whoever placed it: their own, or (sneak and use it with an empty hand to switch) their party's. Anyone may swear the oath, see their standing and fulfil commissions at any lectern. Projects are kept by the world, not the lectern: breaking one loses nothing.
Lecterns
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.descrip: The codex of the Arcane Concordance
book.jugcraft.arcane_concordance.equival: Route essence, smelt, tend gardens and secure a workshop

Mk I / II / III hold **16,384 / 65,536 / 262,144** essence. The three **To dissolve** slots consume plain materials at the same conservative tablet values, at most **8 / 16 / 32 items each second**. The **front textured face** sends **256 / 1,024 / 4,096 essence per second** to a touching condenser, relay, furnace, pedestal or torch. The remaining budget charges its socketed star. Collectors may feed relays from any side. No remote networks or chunk loading.

Use ordinary **smelting recipes** in the three input slots. Dark Matter cooks **one item every two seconds**; Red Matter cooks **up to four per second**. Both cost **16 essence per input**. Three output slots never overwrite items. XP accumulates and is released on taking output or mining the furnace. A charged Klein Star, touching collector or relay, or **Store essence** supplies power. Hoppers insert above/sides and extract below.

The artifact is **kept**. Repair Talisman repairs up to **4 equipped durability points** per nearby party member at **1 essence per point**. Body / Soul / Life Stones restore **food / health / both**, one point for **32 essence**. Up to eight owner/party players within **6 blocks** are served. Harvest Goddess grows at most **4 permitted crop steps for 16 essence each** across a rolling 7x3x7 garden; Concordance organisms still pay nutrients and obey their ecology. Swiftwolf pushes hostile mobs as the torch does. Mature crops are harvested and replanted. Six additional artifact effects cover pickup, XP, defense and workshop acceleration; see **Connected Alchemy**.

Place on the ground or a wall. It lights the area and, while powered, pushes at most **8 visible hostile monsters per second** within **6 blocks**, for **4 essence per target**. Players, pets and neutral creatures are not targets. Dock a charged Klein Star or feed it from a collector or relay. A paused/empty torch remains an ordinary light.

These are deliberate excavation charges: **sneak-use with an empty hand**, or press **Detonate** in the menu. The owner consumes the actual block plus **4,096 / 16,384 personal essence**. Catalyst / Cataclysm clear within radius **2 / 3**, at most **64 / 192 blocks**. They keep normal unenchanted netherite-pick drops and skip inventories, fluids, very hard/unbreakable blocks, other charges, unloaded terrain and protected locations. No fire, entity damage, chain reaction or remote detonation.

Place a block to own it; no research is required. Permission at each affected location still applies. Loaded relays and Matter furnaces may work from their own inventories and buffers while the owner is away. Pedestals, wards and Nova charges still need the real owner online in this dimension. Party members may use menus, but only owners detonate Nova charges. **Pause** or redstone stops work and hopper access. Stars and pedestal artifacts are manual-only. Mine to keep stored essence on the dropped block; inventories drop separately. High Covalence Dust smithing upgrades preserve charge and names. No offline catch-up.
Transmute, repair and gather without casting spells

Craft, find or trade for the equipment and use it immediately. No research, wand or spell cast is needed. Dissolved matter becomes **essence** in your personal **Prima Materia** balance. These tools spend that same balance, also used by the Assayer's Scale. This alchemical essence is separate from Principle essences in vials. No Focus, mana or spell inscription is involved.

Use to open the combined transmutation tablet. Insert an item, then **Dissolve** and **Confirm**: the input is consumed and its default item is learned. Click a learned icon, choose **1 / 16 / 64 / Max**, then **Withdraw** at its essence value with no surcharge. Search and favorites help find learned items. Default magical gear is valued too; empty containers and reset charge, names or other custom state before dissolving. Real input/output items return when the tablet closes. Sneak-use air opens crafting; use terrain transforms it, and sneak-use terrain cycles the area.

Use to toggle **Active**, then hold it or equip it in a **Charm** slot. Every second it repairs up to **4 durability** on one held tool or worn armor piece, for **1 essence per point**. Main hand, offhand, then head-to-feet armor are checked in order. Only damaged items with normal repair ingredients qualify. Enchantments and names are preserved. An active talisman inside a carried Alchemical Bag or owned Alchemical Chest can also repair stored equipment while closed.

Use to toggle **Active**, then hold it or equip it in a **Ring** slot. Every second it draws up to **8 item entities** within **6 blocks** toward you, costing **1 essence for each moved entity**. It stops at solid walls, respects loot ownership and claims, and pauses when your inventory cannot accept the item. Minecraft's ordinary pickup collects it. An active band inside Alchemical storage inserts drops matching a stored item; on a pedestal it inserts into adjacent storage. Mobs are unaffected.

Both passive tools start off. Use again to switch off; the message shows your balance. Active artifacts inside an Alchemical Bag or Chest can repair or collect matching stored item types; ordinary backpacks do not supply that feature. Duplicates do not multiply the effect. Empty balance, missing Assay knowledge or disabled Concordance stops all work. Trade the crafted equipment or formed materials; the ledger stays personal.
Paid alchemical equipment, no spell composer required

Passive artifacts work only while held or worn in the matching Ring/Charm slot, with enough personal **essence**. Merely carrying one does nothing. Use toggles activation; Arcana/Swiftwolf sneak-use changes mode. All areas and entity counts are bounded, claims and friendly-fire checks apply. Equipment uses the wallet first, then carried Klein Stars. Active artifacts can also have bag/chest or pedestal behavior described in Connected Alchemy.

Use: toggle; sneak-use: Flight / Repulsion / Both. Hold or wear. Flight costs 16 essence/s; repulsion 8 per hostile, up to four/s. Double-jump to fly; losing power gives 5s slow falling. No research required.

Use: toggle. Slows up to four nearby visible hostiles for 16 essence each/s. Look at your condenser or Matter furnace within six blocks for one paid extra processing step/s, 128 essence. No global tick acceleration. No research required.

Use: toggle growth. Hold/wear to grow up to four nearby crops each second, 16 essence per step. Use on a ripe crop: harvest and replant, 16 essence. Special crops retain nutrient requirements. No research required.

Use: toggle. Fire protection while burning costs 8 essence/s. Scorches up to four visible nearby hostiles for 16 each/s. Use on an unlit campfire/candle: light it for 8. Does not ignite terrain. No research required.
Use: toggle. Chills and slows up to four visible hostiles within five blocks, 8 essence each/s. Use on source water: temporary frosted ice, 32 essence. No research required.
Use: toggle; sneak-use: Ice / Fire / Harvest / Wind. Combines the corresponding ring behavior and costs; wind combines flight and repulsion. Hold or wear. One mode at a time. No research required.

Use: aimed spirit shot, 8 damage for 64 essence, up to 24 blocks. Sneak-use: toggle automatic shots at visible hostiles within 12 blocks, at most one/s. Hold or wear. No recoverable arrows. No research required.
Use: toggle. Hold or wear to restore one missing food point each second for 64 essence. Duplicate Body/Life stones do not stack. No research required.
Use: toggle. Hold or wear to heal one missing health point each second for 64 essence. Duplicate Soul/Life stones do not stack. No research required.
Use: toggle. Combines Body and Soul stone support; each missing food/health point restored costs 64 essence. Hold or wear. No research required.
Paid alchemical equipment, no spell composer required

Passive artifacts work only while held or worn in the matching Ring/Charm slot, with enough personal **essence**. Merely carrying one does nothing. Use toggles activation; Arcana/Swiftwolf sneak-use changes mode. All areas and entity counts are bounded, claims and friendly-fire checks apply. Equipment uses the wallet first, then carried Klein Stars. Active artifacts can also have bag/chest or pedestal behavior described in Connected Alchemy.
Aim at a block and use: survey its surrounding 3x3x3 loaded volume for ores, up to eight blocks away; 4 essence. Reports up to six ore types. Protected terrain is excluded. No research required.
Aim at a block and use: survey 5x5x5 for ores, up to 16 blocks away; 16 essence. Loaded, permitted terrain only. No research required.
Aim at a block and use: survey 7x7x7 for ores, up to 24 blocks away; 64 essence. Loaded, permitted terrain only. No research required.

Main hand, use on a block: mine a 3x3 face for 16 essence per successful block. Ordinary tool drops/durability and claims apply; containers, fluids and very hard blocks are skipped. No research required.
Main hand, use on a block: mine a 3x3x3 volume for 32 essence per successful block. Ordinary tool drops/durability and claims apply; no explosions or entity damage. No research required.
Main hand, use on a block: mine a broad 5x5 face for 32 essence per successful block. Ordinary tool drops/durability and claims apply. No research required.

Sneak-use or use in air: choose a learned building material. Use a surface: build the selected 1x1 / 3x3 / 5x5 face for formation price + 8 essence per placed block. Without a selected pattern, uses offhand blocks.
Learn and exchange items through shared essence
Once you understand First Light, examine raw matter (**sneak and use**): raw iron, copper or gold, calcite or clay. Study one at a Lampwright's Bench to understand Assay.

Use the scale with a material in your main hand to **weigh** it: its worth in essence (Prima Materia), what the stack would dissolve into, and what forming one costs. Use it again within ten seconds to **dissolve** the stack into your ledger. With an empty main hand and a material in your other hand, use it to **form** one more of it (the one you hold is the scale's pattern and is kept). Dissolving pays the exact worth of the whole stack rounded down; forming costs 1/1 of the worth rounded up, so there is no surcharge and a round trip cannot gain value. Your ledger holds at most 2,000,000,000 essence.

All registered default item types have a value. Empty stored contents and charge first: custom state is never copied or silently discarded. The tablet teaches an item only after consuming it; its learned menu creates the normal default item at its value.

Iron: **256**; gold: **2,048**; diamond: **8,192**; coal: **128**; logs: **32**; planks: **8**. The Tome shows the current full catalogue. Custom items use recipe-derived or provisional local values; those are not historical EE prices.

Dissolve for essence, then spend that essence on learned items. No extra formation fee. Fractional batches round down when dissolved and up when formed. Machine buffers, wallet and stars conserve transfers. Industrial and custom-item prices remain subject to owner playtest tuning.
Learn patterns; automate a living workshop

The tablet opens **dissolving and learned items together**. Put an item into the input, inspect its value and confirm dissolution: the input is consumed and its default form is learned permanently. Choose an icon, then **1 / 16 / 64 / Max** and Withdraw. Pay the exact value, no surcharge, using wallet then carried stars. Max fills one affordable output stack. Empty containers and charge first; custom state is not copied. All registered types are valued; unfamiliar custom items may use provisional local values.

Configure a **Density Gem** or sneak-use a **Void Ring**. Copy up to nine allowed input types into its filter and start it. Only plain matching material is consumed. Density forms its selected iron/gold/diamond target; Void deposits essence. A carried bag or owned chest also supports active **Repair Talisman** and **Black Hole Band**. Seed storage with a desired item to filter pickup. Storage menus pause their own background writer.

Choose **Charge**, **Alchemical Coal**, **Mobius Fuel** or **Aeternalis Fuel** in a collector. Each step consumes one previous fuel and **the difference between input and output item values**. Intermediate fuels remain in output and can continue until the chosen stop. Clear output space is required. Charge mode retains the existing neighbor/star export behavior.

Original six effects remain. **Harvest Goddess now replants ripe crops**. **Black Hole Band** transfers drops into adjacent inventories. **Mind Stone** stores nearby XP, preserving merged orb counts. **Archangel**, **Ignition**, **Zero** defend against monsters. **Watch** gives adjacent furnaces/condensers one extra paid work pulse per second, shared across all Watches. All effects use the pedestal buffer and owner authority.

Stone: use terrain to transmute; sneak-use terrain changes area (1x1, 3x3, 5x5); sneak-use air opens crafting. Each changed block costs at least 8 essence. Eye: open its learned building palette, select a block, then use a surface for a selected **1x1 / 3x3 / 5x5 face**. Each placed block costs formation price plus 8. Claims, collision, reach and loaded terrain apply.

Equipment spends your **wallet first**, then carried Klein Stars. No nested-star access. Gem controls are in the Manual, with optional menu and direct-action keybinds in Controls. Helmet toggles night vision; chest repels enemies; leggings dash; boots toggle paid flight. Flight shares the existing lease and ends on removal or insufficient power. Ordinary wards remain.
Alchemical fuels, covalence and tools powered by essence

Use an ordinary **crafting table**, furnace and anvil. These materials need no new machine and no spell casting. Crafting and single-block mining are available immediately; tool modes use the same essence balance as the tablet, without research. Dissolve surplus plain materials in the tablet to supply it.
Cobblestone and charcoal make four dust. One dust binds four coal into one Alchemical Coal.

**Single block** or **Fell logs**. Follows connected logs of the same block type sideways/upward, including upward diagonals, at most **16 extra**, within four blocks sideways and sixteen upwards. Roots below the first block and leaves are kept. Extra breaks cost **8 essence** each. It can cut placed logs too: sneak for precision.

Tools start in **Single block**. **Sneak while mining** temporarily limits any mode to one block. Every broken block still uses durability and ordinary loot/enchantment rules. Extra blocks must suit the tool and be no harder than the starting block. Containers, block entities, fluid-bearing blocks, protected blocks and unloaded chunks are skipped. Insufficient essence stops extra work; ordinary mining still works. The first block costs no essence. Modes are saved on the tool.
Iron and redstone make four dust. One dust binds two Alchemical Coal into one Mobius Fuel.

Diamond and lapis make four dust. One dust binds two Mobius Fuel into one Aeternalis Fuel. In an **anvil**, one dust also repairs up to **1,024 durability** on a Dark Matter tool, with the usual XP cost. Existing repair enchantments and the Repair Talisman still work.
Burns for **32 ordinary smelts**, at normal speed. The four input coal have the same total burn time; condensation saves storage space, not fuel energy. Dust is consumed.
Burns for **64 ordinary smelts**, at normal speed. Two Alchemical Coal plus Medium Covalence Dust yield one fuel.
Burns for **128 ordinary smelts**, at normal speed. Two Mobius Fuel plus High Covalence Dust yield one fuel. It also feeds the Dark Matter recipe.

Surround a diamond block with eight Aeternalis Fuel. The result is a crafting material, not spendable essence. Fuels, dust, Dark Matter and its tools cannot be dissolved or formed; the tablet explains that they are beyond ordinary equivalence.

**Single block**, **Ore vein**, **Short tunnel**. Use in air to cycle, or sneak-use a block. Vein follows face-connected blocks of the same ore, at most **8 extra** within four blocks of the first. Tunnel mines the next **2 blocks** in the direction you face, stopping at an obstacle. Extra breaks cost **8 essence** each.

**Single block** or **3x3 face**, perpendicular to the direction you face (horizontal when looking steeply up/down). At most **8 extra blocks**, **16 essence** each. Start at the centre of the intended face.
Material equivalence, learned patterns and magical workshops
Carry essence, supply fluids and protect yourself

**Use** a star to open its storage tablet. Store or take **1,024**, **16,384**, or **all available** essence. Transfers stop at the star's capacity or the personal ledger's **2,000,000,000** limit. Nothing is generated or lost. Closing returns the real star. Equipment spends your personal ledger first, then carried stars in inventory order. Nested stars are not power sources. No research required.

**Ein: 4,096**; **Zwei: 16,384**; **Drei: 65,536**; **Vier: 262,144**; **Sphere: 1,048,576**; **Omega: 4,194,304**. At a **smithing table**, put **High Covalence Dust** in the template slot, your current star in the base slot and **Dark Matter** in the addition slot. Each upgrade consumes one dust and one Dark Matter and preserves the star's **charge and custom name**. Filled stars can be traded; on death they follow normal inventory/drop rules. None can be transmuted.

Hold a **plain empty bucket** in your other hand and **use in air** to fill one water bucket for **64 essence**. A stack of buckets needs a spare inventory slot. **Sneak-use** switches its ward on/off. Hold the active amulet or equip it in a **Charm** slot for water breathing while submerged, at **4 essence per second**. The ward is short-lived when you run out or remove it. Crafting returns the two empty buckets.

Fills a carried empty bucket with lava for **4,096 essence**. **Sneak-use** enables a ward granting fire resistance while burning or in lava, for **8 essence per second**. Keep a balance before approaching lava; the ward checks once a second and is not a shield against every damage type. Hold or wear in a **Charm** slot. Crafting returns two buckets.

Wards start **off**, spend essence only while the matching danger is present. Multiple copies do not stack. Existing longer or stronger potions are left alone. Filling a bucket never places fluid in the world: use the ordinary bucket afterward, with normal placement and protection rules. No automatic inventory search, chunk scanning, passive essence generation, flying or new spell system is involved.
Durable tools, protective suits and compact alchemical materials

Combine **three Dark Matter** and **six Aeternalis Fuel**. Upgrade each Dark Matter tool or armor piece at a **smithing table**: High Covalence Dust template, old equipment base, Red Matter addition. Names, damage and enchantments survive. Red tools have **8,192 durability** and netherite-tier harvest. Ordinary use costs no essence.

Use in air, or sneak-use a block, to change mode. **Sneak while mining** for precision. Pickaxe: sixteen connected ores or four more blocks in a tunnel. Axe: twenty-four logs, upward only. Hammer: a 3x3 face. Shovel: 3x3 earth and ordinary path making. Hoe: 3x3 cultivation. Shears: six extra sheep or eight/sixteen connected leaves. Paid work uses the personal essence ledger or carried Klein Stars, loaded chunks and permission. No research is required.

Combine the four Red Matter sword/axe/hoe/shears with four Red Matter and High Covalence Dust. Mines axe/hoe blocks and leaves; strips logs, tills soil, shears sheep, and selects felling or hostile sweep. The combination is ordinary crafting: ingredient enchantments and names are not transferred. **16 essence** per extra log or hostile creature.

Combine Red Matter pickaxe/shovel/hammer, four Red Matter, an Iron Band and High Covalence Dust. Mines pickaxe and shovel materials; makes paths. Select a **3x3 face** or **five-block tunnel**, costing **12 essence** per extra block. Ingredient enchantments and names do not transfer through this crafting recipe.

Single hits/breaks retain normal loot, durability and protection. Extra blocks never include block entities, fluid-bearing blocks, harder materials or protected terrain. An unaffordable operation stops before spending. Most tools cost **8 essence** per extra; hammer and Morning Star **12**; sword and Katar **16**. Sword sweep affects up to **four nearby hostile mobs** for two/four damage and uses the shared Concordance effect boundary. Pets, villagers and players are never swept.

Craft the ordinary armor shapes with Dark Matter. A full enabled suit supplies short **Resistance I** wards, costing **8 essence** each renewal. Red Matter suits cost **12** for resistance and **8** for Fire Resistance while burning. Protection remains ordinary damageable armor even with an empty ledger. Repair each piece in an anvil with High Covalence Dust.

Smith a Red Matter piece with a **diamond block** and High Covalence Dust. Helmet: Water Breathing underwater (**4 essence**). Chestplate: Fire Resistance when burning (**8**). Leggings: Speed I when sprinting (**4**). Boots: Slow Falling after falling two blocks (**4**). Full enabled suit: Resistance I (**12**). Wards last three seconds; checked once a second, they renew only at two seconds or less. Stronger effects are kept. Sneak-use a piece in hand to disable its ward before wearing it. Open **Gem abilities** in the tablet or Manual for paid night vision, repulsion, dash and flight; the boots share the existing flight lease.

Craft nine Dark Matter, Red Matter or any alchemical fuel into its storage block; craft back to exactly nine. Fuel blocks burn for exactly nine times the fuel's duration. These materials, tools and armor are excluded from transmutation: no charged equipment or magical matter can become an essence duplication loop.

The **Alchemical Chest** holds **54 slots** and opens for its owner and party. No hopper can bypass the party gate. Mining spills the real contents separately. Stored items remain physical; explicitly activated, filtered converters can dissolve the chosen plain material types while the chest is closed. No research check can strand existing chest contents.

Craft any of sixteen wool colors around an Alchemical Chest and Low Covalence Dust. Each **bag owns its own 54 slots**, even when two bags share a color. Its inventory slot is locked while open and each transaction saves immediately to that bag. **No nested bags, bundles or container items**. Contents remain accessible if Concordance is disabled. There is no contents-losing recolor recipe.

Use the placed **Transmutation Table** nearby, or carry the **Transmutation Tablet**. Both are usable immediately, without research. Dissolve the input to teach its default item. Browse your learned collection, favorites and search; withdraw 1 / 16 / 64 / Max at its value, no surcharge. Moving away from a table or losing the held tablet closes access without losing its working slots.

The **Alchemical Manual** has six short reference sections. The **Tome of Material Equivalence** browses the server's actual catalogue; click a read-only sample to see dissolution and formation prices. No free sample is delivered, and no research state is changed. Values are shared by all exchange devices.

The **Void Ring** weighs the material held in your other hand; a second use within ten seconds confirms dissolution into your existing balance. Empty stored contents and reset modified stacks before dissolving. Density Gem now opens a nine-entry input filter and selected output tier. Sneak-use Void Ring to configure its optional automatic mode. Empty filters consume nothing. See Connected Alchemy for storage and carried automation.

Use to store **up to 100 actual XP points**; sneak-use returns up to 100. It holds **1,000,000 points** and stores them on the physical item. Transfer is limited by the real XP bar and capacity, never a whole-level exchange rate. Research and feature disable gates still apply. Like other possessions, a lost stone loses its stored XP.
Daylight into essence; essence into chosen materials

Place outdoors in **strong daylight** (sky light minus sky darkness at least **12**). Mk I / II / III gather **1 / 4 / 16 essence per second**, holding **4,096 / 16,384 / 65,536**. Torches cannot power them. Adjacent condensers receive essence first, then the collector charges a **Klein Star** in its socket. Storage works even at night; generation waits for daylight.

Put **one plain catalogued material** into the gold **Target (kept)** slot. That real sample stays there. The condenser makes ordinary copies at the tablet's existing **essence value rounded up per item, without a surcharge**. Mk I / II make up to **1 / 8 items per second** and hold **1,048,576 / 16,777,216 essence**. See the price and pause reason in the interface. Six output slots may hold successive targets.

Touch a collector directly to any condenser face, insert a **charged Klein Star**, or use **Store essence** to move your personal balance into the buffer. The three **To dissolve** slots automatically consume eligible plain materials, at most **8 / 64 items per second**. Never put something there you want to keep. Named, charged, filled and otherwise modified stacks are refused; default magical item types are allowed. Only the **target** is retained; outputs are never fuel.

Hoppers above or at the sides insert dissolution inputs; a hopper **below** extracts outputs. They cannot move the target sample or star. **Pause**, or apply a **redstone signal**, to stop processing and hopper access. Full outputs, missing/invalid targets or an unbalanced server catalogue stop intake before anything is spent. The owner's party may use the interface; automatic neighbour transfers also require related ownership and permission at both ends.

Mine a workshop to carry its essence **on the dropped block**; its sample, inputs, outputs and star drop separately. At a **smithing table**, combine the current block with **High Covalence Dust** in the template slot and **Dark Matter** in the addition slot to upgrade one tier. Stored essence and custom names survive. **Take essence** withdraws to your personal ledger with its normal **2,000,000,000** cap. Default empty workshops and uncharged stars may be transmuted; stored charge is never copied.

Factories record the player who places them as their owner and may keep working while that owner is offline or in another dimension.
