tooltip.jugcraft.altar_keystone: Set into the Ancient Altar of Adam-ondi-Ahman at night: the altars kindle red, and the red mist opens onto Mars
tooltip.jugcraft.ammo_hoist: Stack hoists into a shaft: anything put into one climbs to the top, which hands it to the container above or beside it. Use one with an item in hand to load it.
tooltip.jugcraft.ammonium_perchlorate: The oxidizer in solid rocket fuel.
tooltip.jugcraft.amphibian_boot: Worn on your feet: you swim faster, and your air lasts about twice as long.
tooltip.jugcraft.amulet.controls: Use in air with a plain empty bucket in your other hand. Sneak-use: toggle ward. Hold or wear in a Charm slot. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.angelheart_vial: Worn as a charm: a blow that would kill you leaves you on 2 hearts, healing for 5 seconds. The vial is used up.
tooltip.jugcraft.angelic_feather: Worn as a charm: a fall's harm comes from your food instead of your health while your food bar can pay, 0.5 food a point, and you jump a little higher.
tooltip.jugcraft.antidote: Clears poison, wither and every other harmful effect, and keeps the good ones.
tooltip.jugcraft.arcana_ring: Use: toggle; sneak-use: Ice / Fire / Harvest / Wind. Combines the corresponding ring behavior and costs; wind combines flight and repulsion. Hold or wear. One mode at a time. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.archangel_smite: Use: aimed spirit shot, 8 damage for 64 essence, up to 24 blocks. Sneak-use: toggle automatic shots at visible hostiles within 12 blocks, at most one/s. Hold or wear. No recoverable arrows. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.armoured_walker: A heavily armoured walker with a hull cannon and a piston ram. Walk with the movement keys, hold use to fire the cannon (Heavy Shells) and press attack to ram. Refuel with a diesel or kerosene bucket.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.arbalest: A crossbow with a metal prod: its bolts fly faster and hit harder.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.arbalest.stats: Bolts fly %s%% faster and hit %s%% harder than a crossbow's.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.chain_lash: Use: throw the weighted chain at the first foe in line, up to 9 blocks off, haul it in and reap it. Ready again after 6 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.crescent: Use: loose a crescent wave that runs ahead, through every foe in its way, until it meets a wall. Ready again after 7 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.cyclone: Use: spin three times, cutting every foe about you each time round and drawing them in. Ready again after 6 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.flurry: Use: five quick jabs at the foe ahead, too fast to be shrugged off, then a driving finish. Ready again after 5 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.iaido: Use: dash ahead; every foe you pass is cut a moment later, as the blade comes round. Ready again after 8 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.leap_slam: Use: leap and bring the hammer down where you land: harder at the centre, and harder the further you came down. Ready again after 10 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.art.seven_cuts: Use: seven cuts in a breath, each across every foe ahead, leaving arcs in the air. Ready again after 6 s.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.battle_axe: Chops wood like an axe and breaks a shield's guard for 5 seconds.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.battleblade: A great saw-backed cleaver: each hit wears every piece of the foe's armor.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.bill: A hooked polearm: pulls the foes it strikes towards you and drags riders from the saddle.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.drain: Each hit heals you half a heart.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.ember: A hit sets the foe alight (3 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.frost: A hit chills the foe, slowing it (Slowness II, 3 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.gale: A hit throws the foe up and back.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.harvest: A kill heals you two hearts (once every 5 s), and every fifth kill charges your next blow to loose a pale crescent.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.howl: A hit cows the foe, weakening its blows (Weakness, 3 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.mark: A hit makes the foe glow, seen through walls (4 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.rust: A hit rusts the foe's armor, which counts for 30% less (Rusted, 4 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.shock: A hit arcs to the nearest other foe within 4 blocks, for 30% of the blow.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.stitch: Three hits on one foe within 4 s stitch it, slowing it (Slowness II, 2 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.tide: 25% harder against a foe in water or rain.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.venom: A hit poisons the foe (Poison, 4 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.boon.wither: A hit withers the foe (Wither, 3 s).
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.brazier_mace: A mace whose head is a burning brazier: sets foes alight. Use it to light a campfire, a candle or the ground.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.chakram: A bladed ring, held by its wrapped rim: quick slicing cuts.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.dagger: Quick stabs at a short reach. A blow from behind deals half again as much.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.earthbreaker: A siege hammer. Knocks foes back and breaks a shield's guard for 5 seconds.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.estoc: Thrusts through mail: more damage the more armor the foe wears.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.executioner: Half again as much damage to a foe at or below 30% of its health.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.flail: A hit dazes the foe, slowing it for 2 seconds.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.flanged_mace: Breaks a shield's guard for 3 seconds.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.francisca: A throwing axe with an upswept bit. Chops wood like an axe.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.glaive: A blade on a pole: sweeps at a long reach.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.greatsword: Slow, heavy sweeps with a long reach. Staggers shields.
tooltip.jugcraft.arms.halberd: Thrusts through every foe in line, at a long reach. Breaks a shield's guard for 3 seconds.

tooltip.jugcraft.hag_stone: Looked through at night, standing in shallow water or on mud in a wetland: a lantern burns far off, and the mist takes you to the Lantern Fen
tooltip.jugcraft.hagmoss: Grey moss from the Mire Hag's shawl: makes a cheaper Hag Stone, light grey dye or compost
tooltip.jugcraft.hags_eye: In the offhand, invisible creatures near you glow
tooltip.jugcraft.hags_shawl: A costume: counts for trick-or-treating and the costume contest
tooltip.jugcraft.harvest_goddess_band: Use: toggle growth. Hold/wear to grow up to four nearby crops each second, 16 essence per step. Use on a ripe crop: harvest and replant, 16 essence. Special crops retain nutrient requirements. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.hazmat: Each piece stops 22.5% of nuclear radiation (90% for the full suit)
tooltip.jugcraft.he_rocket: Rocket launcher ammunition: a big blast where it hits (12 hearts at the centre, 5 blocks across).
tooltip.jugcraft.hearthstone: A relic that binds to the first who uses it. Worn as a necklace in an accessory slot, or installed in a Reliquary Shrine: it mends.
tooltip.jugcraft.heavy_shell: Ammunition for the Siege Mortar and the Self-Propelled Howitzer.
tooltip.jugcraft.hex.flying: Rub on for a feather-light fall
tooltip.jugcraft.hex.giant: Makes the drinker a giant, if there is room
tooltip.jugcraft.hex.shrinking: Makes the drinker half their size
tooltip.jugcraft.high_covalence_dust: Binds Mobius into Aeternalis Fuel. Repairs Dark Matter tools in an anvil: up to 1,024 durability per dust.
tooltip.jugcraft.homing_rocket: Rocket launcher ammunition: locks on to the hostile mob nearest your crosshair within 48 blocks and steers into it. A smaller blast.
tooltip.jugcraft.howitzer_walker: A tall artillery walker with a howitzer. Walk with the movement keys; look to aim (your Range Finder mark takes priority); hold use to fire Heavy Shells; jump to spring up; press attack to stomp. Refuel with a diesel or kerosene bucket.
tooltip.jugcraft.howling_totem: Used at night in werewolf country, under the open sky: it howls, something far off answers, and the mist takes you to the Moonlit Ring
tooltip.jugcraft.hydrazine_tank: Sealed 1,000 mB manufacturing charge. Consumed in a compatible Rocket Workshop assembly; not a refillable container.
tooltip.jugcraft.hydrazine_thruster: Fueled assembly: replaces one ordinary motor in survey, weather, delivery or line rocket crafting. Same payload range.
tooltip.jugcraft.hydrogen_cooling_module: Retained Cryogenic Liquefier tool: enables liquid hydrogen and liquid methane.
tooltip.jugcraft.hydrogen_tank: Sealed 1,000 mB manufacturing charge. Consumed in a compatible Rocket Workshop assembly; not a refillable container.
tooltip.jugcraft.hydrolox_motor: Fueled assembly: replaces one ordinary motor in survey, weather, delivery or line rocket crafting. Same payload range.
tooltip.jugcraft.hyperkinetic_lens: Main hand, use on a block: mine a broad 5x5 face for 32 essence per successful block. Ordinary tool drops/durability and claims apply. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.ice_breaker: Worn on your feet: a little knockback resistance, and a fall that hurts you sends a wave through the ground that harms, throws back and slows hostile creatures up to 6 blocks away.
tooltip.jugcraft.ignition_ring: Use: toggle. Fire protection while burning costs 8 essence/s. Scorches up to four visible nearby hostiles for 16 each/s. Use on an unlit campfire/candle: light it for 8. Does not ignite terrain. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.illumination_flare: A white burst that makes hostile mobs within 48 blocks glow for 30 seconds.
tooltip.jugcraft.imperial_crest: The arms of no real empire: a winged cog on a crimson shield. Faces you when placed.
tooltip.jugcraft.imperial_gas_lamp: Burns with a bright, warm white flame.
tooltip.jugcraft.infernal_claws: Worn as a charm: fire's harm (not lava's) comes from your food instead of your health while your food bar can pay, 0.5 food a point.
tooltip.jugcraft.initiate_wand: A first instrument. Hold it to cast the invocations you have understood; a Concordance invocation needs a Concordance instrument in the main hand.
tooltip.jugcraft.interdiction_torch: Standing or wall-mounted light; spends 4 essence per hostile creature pushed away. No player or pet effects.
tooltip.jugcraft.iodine: Leached from kelp with sulfuric acid.
tooltip.jugcraft.iron_band: An iron setting for alchemical rings and devices. Made at an ordinary crafting table.
tooltip.jugcraft.ironclad_pattern: A smithing template: plates a steel zweihander, maul, war pick or battle axe with a steel plate.
tooltip.jugcraft.kaiser_boots: Kaiser: field grey and gilt, the parade dress of the Winged Cog. Protects as steel armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.kaiser_chestplate: Kaiser: field grey and gilt, the parade dress of the Winged Cog. Protects as steel armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.kaiser_helmet: Kaiser: field grey and gilt, the parade dress of the Winged Cog. Protects as steel armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.kaiser_leggings: Kaiser: field grey and gilt, the parade dress of the Winged Cog. Protects as steel armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.kaiser_pattern: A smithing template, made with an Imperial Crest. With a gold ingot it turns a steel helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots into Kaiser armor; with a steel ingot it turns Kaiser armor back. Keeps enchantments and wear.
tooltip.jugcraft.kerosene_tank: A rocket casing filled with RP-1 kerosene, the fuel of a liquid rocket motor.
tooltip.jugcraft.kiln_seal: Pressed into a magma block in the Nether or a volcanic land: the magma opens onto the Cinder Kiln
tooltip.jugcraft.kindled_lantern: Holds Radiance. Use it to light or put it out; lit and in either hand it lights the way round you, and it burns its Radiance whether carried or not. Recharge it at a Lampwright's Bench.
tooltip.jugcraft.klein_star_1: Stores essence. Equipment spends your wallet first, then carried stars in inventory order. Use to store/withdraw; nested stars are not accessed.
tooltip.jugcraft.klein_star_2: Stores essence. Equipment spends your wallet first, then carried stars in inventory order. Use to store/withdraw; nested stars are not accessed.
tooltip.jugcraft.klein_star_3: Stores essence. Equipment spends your wallet first, then carried stars in inventory order. Use to store/withdraw; nested stars are not accessed.
tooltip.jugcraft.klein_star_4: Stores essence. Equipment spends your wallet first, then carried stars in inventory order. Use to store/withdraw; nested stars are not accessed.
tooltip.jugcraft.klein_star_5: Stores essence. Equipment spends your wallet first, then carried stars in inventory order. Use to store/withdraw; nested stars are not accessed.
tooltip.jugcraft.klein_star_6: Stores essence. Equipment spends your wallet first, then carried stars in inventory order. Use to store/withdraw; nested stars are not accessed.
tooltip.jugcraft.kraken_shell: Worn as a charm: drowning's harm comes from your food instead of your health while your food bar can pay, 0.5 food a point.
tooltip.jugcraft.landship: A crawler tank for three. Drive with the movement keys, fire the cannon with attack (it uses cannon shells) and hold use for the side guns. Refuel with a diesel or kerosene bucket.
tooltip.jugcraft.leather_belt: Worn in the Belt slot: one more Charm slot. It cannot be taken off while that slot holds a charm.
tooltip.jugcraft.lesser_fire_focus: Worn in the Spell Focus slot: +2 fire Spell Power, so Cinderbolt and Hearthflare burn hotter. It holds no Focus.
tooltip.jugcraft.leu_fuel_assembly: Standard reactor fuel. A full core is 193 assemblies and runs about a day at full power
tooltip.jugcraft.lichs_crown: A costume: counts for trick-or-treating and the costume contest
tooltip.jugcraft.life_stone: Use: toggle. Combines Body and Soul stone support; each missing food/health point restored costs 64 essence. Hold or wear. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.light_blue_alchemical_b: 54 physical slots in this bag only. No nested containers. Its inventory slot stays locked while open.
tooltip.jugcraft.light_gray_alchemical_b: 54 physical slots in this bag only. No nested containers. Its inventory slot stays locked while open.
tooltip.jugcraft.lime_alchemical_bag: 54 physical slots in this bag only. No nested containers. Its inventory slot stays locked while open.
tooltip.jugcraft.line_rocket: Stand by a zipline anchor and use it while looking at another anchor up to 96 blocks away: it strings a steel line between them.
tooltip.jugcraft.livery: Smithing template: repaints exosuit pieces and the katana, keeping their charge
tooltip.jugcraft.low_covalence_dust: Binds four coal into one Alchemical Coal. Made from cobblestone and charcoal.
tooltip.jugcraft.lowfall_core: In the offhand, you fall as on Mars: slowly, and with no fall damage
tooltip.jugcraft.lox_tank: A rocket casing filled with liquid oxygen, the oxidizer of a liquid rocket motor.
tooltip.jugcraft.magenta_alchemical_bag: 54 physical slots in this bag only. No nested containers. Its inventory slot stays locked while open.
tooltip.jugcraft.map_table: Use it to read the target marks plotted within 256 blocks. Sneak and use it to give the next one to a fire control table within 4 blocks.
tooltip.jugcraft.medium_covalence_dust: Binds two Alchemical Coal into Mobius Fuel. Made from iron and redstone.
tooltip.jugcraft.mendvetch: Plant it in a Verdant Bed: it gives nutrients back to the beds round it.
tooltip.jugcraft.mercurial_eye: Sneak-use or use in air: choose a learned building material. Use a surface: build the selected 1x1 / 3x3 / 5x5 face for formation price + 8 essence per placed block. Without a selected pattern, uses offhand blocks.
tooltip.jugcraft.methalox_motor: Fueled assembly: replaces one ordinary motor in survey, weather, delivery or line rocket crafting. Same payload range.
tooltip.jugcraft.methane_cooling_module: Retained Cryogenic Liquefier tool: enables liquid methane. LOX needs no tool.
tooltip.jugcraft.methane_tank: Sealed 1,000 mB manufacturing charge. Consumed in a compatible Rocket Workshop assembly; not a refillable container.
tooltip.jugcraft.mind_stone: Use stores 100 XP; sneak-use retrieves 100. On a pedestal, collects nearby XP into this physical stone. The lit icon indicates stored XP.
tooltip.jugcraft.mixed_farm_blend: 5x5 crops: 3 growth applications per crop. Useful for mixed farms.
tooltip.jugcraft.mobius_fuel: Furnace fuel: 64 ordinary smelts. Also a material for Aeternalis Fuel.
tooltip.jugcraft.mobius_fuel_block: Nine units stored losslessly. Craft back into nine materials.
tooltip.jugcraft.module_fitting: Use it on a charging station holding the tool
tooltip.jugcraft.mortar: Hold an ingredient in your other hand and use this to grind one: ground, it dissolves faster but loses a little. A Dried Chili grinds into Paprika.
tooltip.jugcraft.mourning_wreath: Lay it on a grave for the Last Rites
tooltip.jugcraft.mulch_maw: Feed it plant matter: it gives the nutrients to the poorest Verdant Bed round it.
tooltip.jugcraft.n2o4_tank: Sealed 1,000 mB manufacturing charge. Consumed in a compatible Rocket Workshop assembly; not a refillable container.
tooltip.jugcraft.nitrogen_fertilizer: 5x5 crops: 4 growth applications to grains, leaves and fibre; 1 to other crops.

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.air_handling_un: Filters and moves a building's air (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.chw_pump: Pumps chilled water from the air handlers' coils through its chiller
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.circulating_wat: Moves the cooling water round the cooling towers: a tower only works with these on its conduit (each one carries half a unit's heat)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.cr_air_handling: Cools and circulates the control room's air (its filters, chilled water coil and supply fan); runs as the HVAC panel has it
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.cr_chiller: Chills the water for the control room's air handlers; its panel shows its temperatures and load
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.cr_filtration_u: Charcoal and HEPA filters the control room's outside air when the HVAC panel goes to emergency (a reactor trip or high temperature); its booster fan starts on its own
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.dry_storage_cas: A ventilated concrete cask for cooled spent fuel (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.electrical_cont: Offsite power, the station busses and the diesel generators (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.emergency_diese: Backup power for the safety systems if the grid is lost (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.epr_reactor_ves: The EPR's larger core: 241 assemblies and 1.6 times the output. Needs two turbine-generators to use it all
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.esf_control_boa: The safety injection, residual heat removal and containment spray trains (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.feedwater_heate: Warms the feedwater with steam bled from the turbine (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.feedwater_pump: Sends the condensed water back to the steam generators (on the steam line)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.fuel_handling_m: The bridge that moves fuel round the spent fuel pool (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.heat_exchanger: A component cooling heat exchanger (for show)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.main_transforme: The unit's power comes out here, into cables or a Unit Substation

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.moisture_separa: Dries and reheats the steam between the turbine stages (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.overhead_crane: The turbine hall's bridge crane (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.plant_display_w: The control room's large plant overview display (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.polar_crane: The containment's round-the-dome crane (for building your own plant: it only looks the part)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.pump_skid: A plant pump and motor on its baseplate (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.radiation_contr: The radiation monitors, ventilation and fire detection (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.rcs_control_boa: The coolant loops, coolant pumps, pressurizer, charging and letdown (for show)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.reactor_coolant: Drives the primary coolant: one per steam generator
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.reactor_pressur: Holds the core. Joins its unit through Reactor Coolant Pipe
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.reactor_steam_g: Boils the steam. Each one (with a coolant pump) carries a quarter of the heat
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.refueling_machi: The gantry that lifts fuel out of the open reactor (for show)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.secondary_contr: The steam generators' levels, feedwater and main steam (for show)
tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.size: %s wide, %s deep, %s tall (placed to your right and away from you)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.spent_fuel_rack: Holds used fuel under water; the water glows blue over it (for show)

tooltip.jugcraft.nuclear.turbine_control: The turbine's controls and the generator's meters and breakers (for show)

tooltip.jugcraft.reliquary_shrine: Use with a relic: install it, or recharge it from a Ley Pylon beside the shrine. Empty hand: take it back.
tooltip.jugcraft.repair_talisman: Activated while held/worn: repairs equipment. Activated inside a carried bag or owned chest: repairs stored gear. 1 essence per point, up to 4 each second.
tooltip.jugcraft.research_notes: Use blank to write down what you know; others read what you wrote
tooltip.jugcraft.research_notes.author: Notes by %s
tooltip.jugcraft.research_notes.blank: Blank: use it to write down what you know
tooltip.jugcraft.resonant_ring: Forged at an Artificer's Bench. Wear it in a ring slot; its properties are rolled once.
tooltip.jugcraft.rocket_launcher: Fires a rocket from your inventory. Rockets hurt living things only: they never break blocks.
tooltip.jugcraft.rocket_motor: A loaded rocket motor, ready for a payload.
tooltip.jugcraft.rocket_pack: Hold jump in the air to fly
tooltip.jugcraft.runecarvers_pattern: A smithing template: binds glowing runes to a steel nodachi, moonblade, quarterstaff or war hammer, with ectoplasm.
tooltip.jugcraft.salamander_charm: In the offhand, hot ground never burns you: magma blocks and molten slag
tooltip.jugcraft.salicylic_acid: Steeped from willow or birch bark. Acetylated with cider vinegar, it makes aspirin.
tooltip.jugcraft.salvaged_coil: Copper from the Iron Dreadnought's coils: makes cheaper Sealed Orders, or redstone
tooltip.jugcraft.salve: Use it on a creature to apply it (or on yourself, sneaking).
tooltip.jugcraft.sampling_spoon: Use it on an Alembic Crucible: how hot, how much, and what it tastes of.
tooltip.jugcraft.sandbags: Shrugs off blasts: build parapets and gun pits.
tooltip.jugcraft.scrying_glass: Use it to see the curses on you; with a remedy in your other hand, to lift them; with a taglock, to read its link.
tooltip.jugcraft.scuba_tank: Use on a tank or gas holder of oxygen to fill. Wear it with the scuba mask.
tooltip.jugcraft.sealed_orders: Used on a Field Telephone that stands in a trench, under the open sky: the line crackles, and a whistle calls you to the Foundry Trench
tooltip.jugcraft.searchlight: Use to turn it, sneak and use to tilt it. A redstone signal switches it off.
tooltip.jugcraft.self_propelled_howitzer: A tracked gun. Drive with the movement keys; attack fires a Heavy Shell at your marked target, or where you look. Refuel with a diesel or kerosene bucket.
tooltip.jugcraft.sentinels_visor: A costume: counts for trick-or-treating and the costume contest
tooltip.jugcraft.siege_mortar: A fixed heavy mortar. Climb aboard and press attack to lob a Heavy Shell at your marked target, or where you look. Its bursts hurt creatures but never break blocks.
tooltip.jugcraft.signal_flare: A red star burst seen from far away; players within 512 blocks are told where it went up.
tooltip.jugcraft.silk_touch_module: Blocks drop themselves (drill or chainsaw; not with fortune)
tooltip.jugcraft.silver_iodide: Seeds clouds: water freezes onto its crystals.
tooltip.jugcraft.sliding_gate: Steel bars that slide aside on a redstone signal. Gates side by side or stacked open together.
tooltip.jugcraft.smoke_grenade: A thick smoke screen for 15 seconds: mobs lose sight of anyone inside, and players inside without a mask can't see.
tooltip.jugcraft.solid_propellant: Ammonium perchlorate and aluminum in a rubber binder.
tooltip.jugcraft.soul_stone: Use: toggle. Hold or wear to heal one missing health point each second for 64 essence. Duplicate Soul/Life stones do not stack. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.speed_upgrade: Each: faster, uses more energy per item (up to 4 count)
tooltip.jugcraft.spent_fuel_assembly: Deadly radioactive: carry it in a full hazmat suit, and store it behind shielding
tooltip.jugcraft.spire_heart: Found a Concord Spire here (a Master's work); use it with an empty hand to see how it stands.
tooltip.jugcraft.spirit_anchor: Use: seal a Gathering Shade's agreement. Its holder, sneaking: suspend or resume. Break: release.
tooltip.jugcraft.star.use: Use: open essence storage. Close to reclaim the star. Upgrade at a smithing table; stored essence is kept.
tooltip.jugcraft.starbuncle_charm: Use on the ground to summon your courier. Select it with a Dominion Wand, then select a pickup chest and delivery chest.
tooltip.jugcraft.steampunk_boots: Steampunk: bronze and copper, with goggles and a boiler on the back. Protects as bronze armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.steampunk_chestplate: Steampunk: bronze and copper, with goggles and a boiler on the back. Protects as bronze armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.steampunk_helmet: Steampunk: bronze and copper, with goggles and a boiler on the back. Protects as bronze armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.steampunk_leggings: Steampunk: bronze and copper, with goggles and a boiler on the back. Protects as bronze armor does.
tooltip.jugcraft.steampunk_pattern: A smithing template. With a copper ingot it turns a bronze helmet, chestplate, leggings or boots into Steampunk armor; with a bronze ingot it turns Steampunk armor back. Keeps enchantments and wear.
tooltip.jugcraft.steel_i_beam: Lies along the axis you place it on, like a log.
tooltip.jugcraft.steel_ladder: Rungs on two steel rails, for tower shafts.
tooltip.jugcraft.stimulant: Speed II and Haste II for a minute, and hungry for it.
tooltip.jugcraft.stirring_rod: Use it on an Alembic Crucible to stir the mixture once.
tooltip.jugcraft.storable_bipropellant_m: Fueled assembly: replaces one ordinary motor in survey, weather, delivery or line rocket crafting. Same payload range.
tooltip.jugcraft.stormglass: A relic. Held in the main hand under the open sky, it quickens your step. It cannot be installed.
tooltip.jugcraft.structure_reach: Places up to %s blocks further than a block (in the main hand)
tooltip.jugcraft.sunpetal: Plant it in a Verdant Bed; harvested, an alchemical ingredient bright with Radiance.
tooltip.jugcraft.survey_rocket: Fire it straight up: from the top it surveys the ores and oil under 7x7 chunks.
tooltip.jugcraft.swiftwolf_rending_gale: Use: toggle; sneak-use: Flight / Repulsion / Both. Hold or wear. Flight costs 16 essence/s; repulsion 8 per hostile, up to four/s. Double-jump to fly; losing power gives 5s slow falling. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.taglock: Use it on a creature to take a link to it. Then, with a curse's reagent in your other hand, use it to cast that curse through the link.
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_kit.corrosive: Rubber-lined for corrosive liquids: acids, lye, electrolyte (and general liquids)
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_kit.cryogenic: Vacuum-insulated, for cryogenic liquids: liquid oxygen
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_kit.flammable: Rated for flammable liquids: fuels, naphtha, crude oil (and general liquids)
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_kit.general: Holds water, brine, fracking fluid and other general liquids
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_kit.use: Use on the ground to place the whole tank, reaching away from you. Breaking any part of it takes it all down and gives the kit back, empty
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_rubber_lining: Use on an empty storage tank to re-rate it for corrosive liquids
tooltip.jugcraft.tank_shell_section: Nine tank plates welded into a curved section: what tank kits are made of
tooltip.jugcraft.tatterlace_headdress: A costume: counts for trick-or-treating and the costume contest
tooltip.jugcraft.thallite.regrowth: While you stand on living soil, it mends one use every 5 s, up to 75% of full.
tooltip.jugcraft.thallite.rooted: On natural ground, each Earthbound piece takes 7.5% off knockback (30% for a full set). With two or more worn, Regrowth works on stone, sand and gravel too.
tooltip.jugcraft.thermite: Aluminum and iron oxide: burns white-hot once lit.
tooltip.jugcraft.thermite_grenade: Leaves a white-hot pool for 6 seconds that burns whatever stands in it, through armor. Never lights blocks.
tooltip.jugcraft.thornheart_blade: Living: it grows by slaying, enduring and being fed, never by one deed repeated.
tooltip.jugcraft.timber_shoring: Squared timber with an iron strap, to hold up a dugout's roof.
tooltip.jugcraft.transmutation_table: A placed essence tablet. Use within eight blocks where building is permitted. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.transmutation_tablet: Dissolve an item to learn it permanently. Browse learned items, choose 1/16/64/Max and spend their essence value with no surcharge. Stored contents and charge must be emptied first.
tooltip.jugcraft.trench_periscope: Two blocks tall: its mirror head looks over the parapet the way you face when you place it. A comparator reads how many hostile mobs it sees; use it to mark the nearest for your guns (sneak: clear your mark).
tooltip.jugcraft.triple_battery: A three-barrelled turret for a 5x5 tower top. Each press fires a salvo of three Heavy Shells.
tooltip.jugcraft.triple_superphosphate: 5x5 crops: 4 growth applications to roots, legumes and fruiting crops; 1 to others.
tooltip.jugcraft.tyrant_crest: A costume: counts for trick-or-treating and the costume contest
tooltip.jugcraft.tyrant_scale: A scale of the Cinder Tyrant's obsidian: crushes into magma cream, and makes a cheaper Kiln Seal
tooltip.jugcraft.verdant_bed: Soil for the Greenwardens' crops: it holds water like farmland and up to 32 nutrients. A Greenwarden's touch wakes it.
tooltip.jugcraft.verdant_chaff: What a harvest leaves: feed it to a Mulch Maw.
tooltip.jugcraft.verdant_heart: Set on a Verdant Bed: in a lit, fed and varied garden it beats nutrients into Verdance.
tooltip.jugcraft.void_ring: Use: confirm dissolving the other-hand material. Sneak-use: configure filtered automatic dissolution. Empty filters consume nothing.
tooltip.jugcraft.volcanite_amulet: Fills a carried bucket for 4,096 essence. Active ward: fire resistance while burning or in lava, 8 essence per second.
tooltip.jugcraft.ward_sigil: Use it to ward yourself for twenty minutes.
tooltip.jugcraft.wardlight: A relic. Held in the off hand, or installed in a Reliquary Shrine: hostile creatures nearby glow.
tooltip.jugcraft.watch_of_flowing_time: Use: toggle. Slows up to four nearby visible hostiles for 16 essence each/s. Look at your condenser or Matter furnace within six blocks for one paid extra processing step/s, 128 essence. No global tick acceleration. No research required.
tooltip.jugcraft.white_alchemical_bag: 54 physical slots in this bag only. No nested containers. Its inventory slot stays locked while open.
tooltip.jugcraft.workshop.stored: Stored essence: %s. Mining keeps this charge; inventories drop separately.
tooltip.jugcraft.wrought_iron_lattice: See-through: railings, screens and grand station roofs.
tooltip.jugcraft.yellow_alchemical_bag: 54 physical slots in this bag only. No nested containers. Its inventory slot stays locked while open.
tooltip.jugcraft.yeti_fur: The Yeti King's fur: shears into white wool, and makes a cheaper Frost Horn
tooltip.jugcraft.yeti_king_crown: A costume: counts for trick-or-treating and the costume contest
tooltip.jugcraft.yeti_mitten: In the offhand, its wearer never freezes: powder snow, frost and blizzards leave them warm
tooltip.jugcraft.zeppelin: A diesel airship for four, with a cargo hold. Fly: movement keys, jump to climb, sprint to sink. Use a diesel or kerosene bucket on it to refuel; sneak-use for the cargo hold.

jugcraft.nouveau_density_tooltip: Amount and shape of particles spawned over time
jugcraft.nouveau_documentation.intro1: Welcome to Jug Nouveau! If you are new, following Getting Started and completing the Advancements is recommended.
jugcraft.nouveau_documentation.intro2: Join the discord to share spells, ask questions, and see what's coming next!
jugcraft.nouveau_dynamic_lights.button_o: Dynamic lights are turned on.  This can cause lag for users with weaker CPUs, low RAM allocation, and unexpected results with 'performance' mods like Optifine.
jugcraft.nouveau_earth_essence.tooltip: Can be used on Dirt to turn it into Grass.
jugcraft.nouveau_effect_icon_tooltip: Effects: Determines what the spell does after hitting a target.
jugcraft.nouveau_enchanting.bad_level: This item must have the previous level of enchantment.
jugcraft.nouveau_enchanting.incompatible: This enchantment is incompatible with this item.
jugcraft.nouveau_familiar.script: Used for obtaining familiars. Obtained from the Ritual of Binding.
jugcraft.nouveau_familiar_desc.familiar_: Reduces knockback taken by half and knocks back any attackers. Giving the golem an Amethyst Shard will grant 3 minutes of Shielding.

A Bookwyrm will automatically pickup nearby items and exp orbs within 5 blocks of the player. Thrown items will not be picked up. Use of the familiar hotkey is recommended to turn the magnet on and off as needed. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Bookwyrm.
A Drygmy familiar will increase the damage of Earth spells by 2, and has a chance to increase the amount of looting when slaying enemies. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Drygmy.

A Starbuncle familiar that will grant you Speed 2. Additionally, using a Golden Nugget on the starbuncle will consume it and grant the owner a short duration of Scrying for Gold Ore. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Starbuncle.
Whirlisprigs will reduce the cost of Elemental Earth glyphs by half, and grants bonus saturation when consuming food. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Whirlisprig.

Wixies will increase the duration of potions that you apply, and wixies will accept basic potion reagents in exchange for applying the tier 1 potion result. Additionally, the Wixie will apply harmful potions to enemies during combat. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Wixie.
jugcraft.nouveau_filter_icon_tooltip: Filters: Prevents the spell from resolving if the target does not match the filter.
jugcraft.nouveau_fire_essence.tooltip: Can be used as a fuel source.
jugcraft.nouveau_fishing_rod.invalid: Invalid Spell. Enchanter's Fishing Rod accept Effects and Augments only.
jugcraft.nouveau_form_icon_tooltip: Forms: Appear at the start of the spell and determine how it is cast.
jugcraft.nouveau_gauntlet.invalid: Invalid spell. Gauntlets accept Effects and Augments only.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_accele: Increases the speed of projectile spells.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_amplif: Additively increases the power of most spell effects. Can increase the harvest level of Break and increases the damage of spells.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_animat: Animates a block to fight for you. The animated block will convert to a falling block when it dies. Costs a large amount of mana, but does not grant Summoning Sickness
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_aoe: Spells will affect a larger area around a targeted block.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_blink: Teleports the caster to a location. If an entity is hit and the caster is holding a Warp Scroll in the offhand, the entity will be warped to the location on the Warp Scroll. When used on Self, the caster blinks forward. Spell Turrets and Runes can warp entities using Warp Scrolls from adjacent inventories without consuming the scroll.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_bounce: Gives players the Bounce effect, causing them to bounce upwards upon falling. Amplification of Bounce will preserve additional forward facing motion per bounce.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_break: Breaks blocks of an average hardness. Can be amplified to increase the harvest level. Sensitive will simulate breaking blocks with Shears instead of a pickaxe.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_bubble: Captures mobs and entities it touches, causing them to float upwards. If the bubble has been alive for at least one tick, damaging the entity trapped in the bubble will cause it to pop, dealing bonus damage to the entity inside. Extend time and amplify can be used to increase the duration and damage of the bubble.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_burst: Resolves the spell in a spherical area around the target. Augment with Sensitive to target blocks instead of entities and Dampen to make an empty sphere. Augment with AOE to increase the radius.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_cold_s: Causes wet, slowed, or freezing entities to take a burst of damage and erupt into falling ice. Falling ice will slow and damage nearby entities. Can also be used to erupt a block of ice instead. Falling blocks of ice can be manipulated with the Focus of Block Shaping. Entities afflicted with Freezing will be set to the maximum freeze level immediately.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_conjur: Places water at a location or extinguishes entities on fire. If augmented with extend time, it will keep entities wet for a longer period of time.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_crush: Turns stone into gravel, and gravel into sand. Will also crush flowers into bonus dye. Need Sensitive to work on items. For full recipe support, see JEI. Will also harm entities and deals bonus damage to entities that are swimming.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_cut: Simulates using shears on entities and blocks, or damages non-shearable entities for a small amount. Amplify will simulate using an Axe instead of Shears. For simulating breaking with shears, see Break and Sensitive. Costs nothing.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_dampen: Decreases the power of most spells.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_decele: Decreases the speed of projectile spells.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_delay: Delays the resolution of effects placed to the right of this spell for a few moments. The delay may be increased with the Extend Time augment, or decreased with Duration Down.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_dispel: Removes any potion effects on the target. When used on a witch at half health, the witch will vanish in return for a Wixie shard. Will also dispel tamed summons back into their charm.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_durati: Reduces the duration of spells like potion effects, delay, redstone signal, and others.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_ender_: Opens your personal ender chest inventory from anywhere.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_evapor: Deletes fluids in an area. Can be expanded with AOE.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_exchan: When used on blocks, exchanges the blocks in the players hotbar for the blocks hit as if they were mined with silk touch. Can be augmented with AOE, and Amplify is required for swapping blocks of higher hardness. When used on entities, the locations of the caster and the entity hit are swapped.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_explos: Causes an explosion at the location. Amplify increases the damage and size by a small amount, while AOE will increase the size of the explosion by a large amount, but not damage.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_extend: Extends the time that spells last, including buffs, fangs, and summons
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_extrac: Applies a silk-touch effect to Break and causes Explosion to not destroy blocks that drop. Cannot be combined with Fortune.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_fangs: Summons Evoker Fangs in the direction where the spell was targeted. Using fangs on your self will spawn them in an area around you.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_fell: Harvests entire trees, mushrooms, cactus, and other vegetation. Can be amplified with Amplify to break materials of higher hardness. AOE will increase the number of blocks that may be broken at one time.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_firewo: Creates a firework at the location or entity. Amplify will add Firework Stars, while Extend Time will add additional flight time. If a firework exists in the casters inventory, the created firework will mimic the held one. Spell Turrets with Touch will create fireworks as if they were dispensed.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_flare: When used on an entity or block that is on fire or afflicted with Blasting, Cinders will explode around the target, dealing damage and creating Mage Fire nearby. Mage Fire cannot spread to blocks and is short lived. Entities with Blasting will immediately explode for extra strength.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_fortun: Increases the drop chance from mobs killed by Damage and blocks that are destroyed by Break. Cannot be combined with Extract.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_freeze: Freezes water or lava in a small area or slows a target for a short time. Freeze on Ice will turn it into Packed Ice, and Packed Ice into Blue Ice. Sensitive will turn water into Frosted Ice and will vanish after a short time.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_glide: Grants the Glide effect, allowing the wearer to fly as if they were wearing an Elytra.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_gravit: Causes blocks and entities to fall. When augmented with Extend Time, players will have their flight disabled and will obtain the Gravity effect. While afflicted with Gravity, entities will rapidly fall and take double falling damage.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_grow: Causes plants to accelerate in growth as if they were bonemealed.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_gust: Knocks a target or block away a short distance from the caster. Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_harm: Damages a target. May be increased by Amplify, or applies the Poison debuff when using a Time augment. Note, multiple Harms without a delay will not apply due to invincibility on hit.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_harves: When used on grown crops, this spell will obtain the fully grown product without destroying the plant.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_heal: Heals a small amount of health and consumes hunger from the caster. When used on Undead, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic damage.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_hex: Applies the Hex effect. Hex increases any damage taken by a small amount while the user is afflicted by poison, wither, fire, or when frozen. Additionally, Hex cuts the rate of Mana Regeneration and healing in half.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_ignite: Sets blocks and mobs on fire for a short time. Sensitive will summon Mage Fire, a shorter lived fire that will not spread or destroy blocks.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_infuse: Infuses a target with a potion or flask from your inventory. If augmented with AOE, a splash potion will spawn at the location. If augmented with Extend Time, a lingering potion will spawn at the location. Caster blocks may pull from adjacent Potion Jars to cast infuse.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_intang: Causes blocks to temporarily turn into air. Can be modified with Amplify for blocks of higher hardness, AOE, Duration Down, and Extend Time.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_intera: Interacts with blocks or entities as it were a player. Useful for reaching levers, chests, or animals. Sensitive will use your off-hand item on the block or entity, Amplify will use left-click instead of right-click on blocks.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_invisi: Causes the target to turn invisible for a short time.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_launch: Launches an entity or block into the air. Can be used for large jumps, yeeting mobs in the sky or for scaling mountains! Sensitive will stop this spell from launching blocks.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_leap: Launches the target in the direction they are looking. Amplification will increase the distance moved.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_light: If cast on a block, a permanent light source is created. May be amplified up to Glowstone brightness, or Dampened for a lower light level. When cast on yourself, you will receive night vision. When cast on other entities or with Sensitive, they will receive Night Vision and Glowing. If Sensitive, Glowing will use the spell color. Particles can be configured from the Spell Style menu in the spellbook.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_lightn: Summons a lightning bolt at the location. Entities struck will be given the Shocked effect. Shocked causes all additional lightning damage to deal bonus damage, and increases the level of Shocked up to III. Lightning also deals bonus damage to entities that are wet or wearing RF powered items. Can be augmented with Amplify, Dampen, and Extend Time.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_linger: Creates a lingering field that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_name: Names an entity after the set Spell Name. Targeting a block will name nearby entities or name inventory blocks directly if possible. Targeting with Self will name the held offhand item. Can be overridden with a name tag in the hotbar.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_orbit: Summons three orbiting projectiles around the target that will cast a spell on any entities it may hit. Additional projectiles, their speed, radius, and duration may be augmented. Sensitive will cause Orbit to hit blocks.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_pantom: Applies spells to the nearest block in your line of sight. Dampen will reduce the distance, Amplify will increase it. Sensitive will highlight the selected block.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_phanto: Creates a temporary block that will disappear after a short time. Amplify will cause the block to be permanent. Dispelling this block will destroy it instantly. Casting on an entity will create blocks around them in the upwards direction.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_pickup: Picks up nearby items in a medium radius where this spell is activated. The range may be expanded with AOE.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_pierce: When applied to the Projectile spell, projectiles may continue through their path an additional time after hitting a mob or block. Causes certain effects to also target the block behind them, like Break. Combines with AOE to provide depth.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_place_: Places blocks from the casters inventory. If cast by a player, this spell will place blocks from the hot bar first. Casting on an entity will place the blocks beneath the entity in the up direction. Sensitive causes the block to be placed in the caster's facing direction, two Sensitives will place it in the opposite direction.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_presti: Places an invisible temporary block that emits particles. Amplify will make this block permanent. Particles can be configured from the Spell Style menu in the spellbook. Targeting an entity will emit particles centered on them instead.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_projec: Summons a projectile that applies spell effects when this projectile hits a target or block. Sensitive will allow Projectiles to break plants or other materials that do not block motion.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_pull: Pulls the target closer to the caster. When used on blocks, they become falling blocks with motion towards the side of the block that was hit. Sensitive will stop this spell from pulling blocks.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_random: Randomize the behavior of some glyphs. If used with spells like Place Block and Exchange, it will randomize the block that is placed between the blocks in your hotbar.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_redsto: Places a temporary block of redstone with configurable power and duration. Augment with Sensitive to set the target block as a power source for itself and surrounding blocks. Dampen and Amplify will adjust the power from the base value of 10.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_rotate: Rotates a block or an entity clockwise. If augmented with sensitive it will change the axis of the block (if possible) or force the entity to turn their look. Dampen will rotate counter-clockwise.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_rune: Places a rune on the ground that will cast the spell on targets that touch the rune. Unlike runes placed by Runic Chalk, these runes are temporary and cannot be recharged. When using Item Pickup, items are deposited into adjacent inventories. Sensitive will cause the rune to use the Owner's inventory for pickup and usage instead. Players with Magic Find will be able to read spells inscribed on runes.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_sense_: Applies Magic Find to the target, causing magical mobs to glow within 75 blocks of them. Magic Find also reveals spells on Runes.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_sensit: Causes forms to target blocks they normally cannot target. Projectile and Orbit will target grass, and Touch will target fluids and air. Changes targeting rules of certain effects.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_smelt: Smelts blocks and items in the world. AOE will increase the number of items and radius of blocks that can be smelted at once, while Amplify will allow Smelt to work on blocks of higher hardness, Sensitive will make it only smelt items and not blocks. Dampen will cause Smelt to use smoking recipes.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_snare: Stops entities from moving and jumping. Extend Time will increase the duration of this effect. Snaring a block created from the Focus of Block Shaping will cause it to attempt to place itself immediately.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_split: Causes multiple projectiles to be cast at once. Each projectile applies a set of effects.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_summon: Summons a decoy of yourself. Upon summoning, the decoy will attract any nearby mobs to attack it.

Summons a saddled horse that will vanish after a few minutes. AOE will increase the amount summoned, while Extend Time will increase the duration of the summon. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, and cannot be cast while afflicted by this Sickness.

Summons a number of Skeleton allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Skeletons will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.  Additionally, their summoned weapons are changed using augments, use Amplify to give it a better sword, or Pierce to give it a bow.  Adding Split after the effect will add to the number of summoned skeletons.
Summons three Vex allies that will attack nearby hostile enemies. These Vex will last a short time until they begin to take damage, but time may be extended with the Extend Time augment.
Summons two wolves that will fight with you. Extend Time will increase the amount of time on the summons. Applies Summoning Sickness to the caster, preventing other summoning magic.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_toss: Causes the caster to place an item from their inventory to a location. If this glyph is used on an inventory, the item will attempt to be inserted into it. Toss throws 64 items by default. Dampen will halve the amount each time. Amplify will double the amount each time. Randomize will select a random stack.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_touch: Applies spells at the block or entity that is targeted.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_underf: Targets the spell on the block beneath the player.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_wall: Creates a lingering wall that applies spells on nearby entities for a short time. Applying Sensitive will make this spell target blocks instead. AOE will expand the effective range, Accelerate will cast spells faster, Dampen will ignore gravity, and Extend Time will increase the duration.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_wind_b: Activates a wind charge at the target location, knocking entities back. Sensitive will allow the caster to ignore the knockback.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.glyph_wind_s: Deals damage to targets in the air, with an increasing amount based on how high the target is off the ground, up to 10 blocks. Targets on the ground take no damage.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.reset: Resets the spell chain to the original target if it was changed by a previous effect. For example, Burst -> Place Block -> Reset -> Break will cause Burst to place blocks, but only Break will apply to the original location. As a result, using Reset will allow you to bypass combination and duplicate limits on glyphs.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.rewind: Rewinds an entity back in time to its previous locations and health. Can revert blocks that were moved with spells back into solid blocks. Glyphs that come after Rewind will be cast at the end of the rewind, as if they were Delayed.
jugcraft.nouveau_glyph_desc.wololo: Changes the color of an entity or compatible block to the color of the spell.
jugcraft.nouveau_gui.discord: Join the Discord for spells, updates, and support!
jugcraft.nouveau_imbuement.crafting_star: Crafting %s. Add source nearby to increase craft speed.
jugcraft.nouveau_imbuement.norecipe: No recipe found. If pedestals are required, they must be placed within the 1 block cube around the chamber.
jugcraft.nouveau_imbuement.use_apparatus: Did you mean to use an Enchanting Apparatus for this recipe?
